jobs.title: Senior Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
IOA is on the forefront of revolutionary healthcare models, reshaping the way people can age in place. Our innovative models transform lives, enhance communities, and save healthcare systems millions of dollars. Rather than focusing on archaic outdated design, we strive to consistently question the “status\-quo” and create new and more innovative ways to help aging adults and adults with disabilities maintain their quality of life.


With over 23 programs, we offer multiple ways to aid seniors maintain their health, well\-being, independence and participation in the community, fulfilling our mission.


Urgently hiring.
  

Serving as the key administrative support team member to the Enrichment Center and supporting other Companioa Programs, this role requires a highly organized and proactive individual to ensure maximum efficiency and streamline operations in a highly dynamic team. Primary duties include supporting client referral to enrollment process, client records compliance, transportation management, supply management, and program coordination.**Prospects, Tours \& Enrollments**

* Maintain a thorough knowledge of all dementia services to communicate Companioa programs effectively and accurately to referral sources, prospects, and other visitors to the Enrichment Center.
* Receive all incoming calls to main line at the Enrichment Center \& provide response within 1 business day.
* Facilitate tours of the Enrichment Center for prospects and referral sources as needed and conduct timely follow up after tour to identify next steps.
* Proactively engage Director as enrollment barriers arise.
* Assist new client / family with Enrichment Center enrollment paperwork.
* Ensure all new clients have a successful transition to designated Companioa programs.
* Assist in completing \& submitting transit applications and supplemental documentation for all impacted new enrollees.
**Client Records \& Billing Management**

* Maintain daily attendance log with updates, notes, and client\-specific needs.
* Enter client status updates (enrollment, disenrollment, hold, etc.) and notes for all communication with prospects and clients into electronic health record within 2 business days.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records for all funder \& grant contracts using required systems.
* Completely and accurately follow client file checklists to ensure files are complete, current, and in compliance with licensing.
* Manage client roster for Enrichment Center and Care Coaching programs. This includes, providing enrollment and disenrollment information in the client health record and submitting accurate attendance reports to billing department.
* Maintain emergency rosters for all enrolled clients with a minimum of monthly updates.
* Collaborate with program liaisons at Veterans Administration, SF Department of Disability and Aging Services, and other grant/funders as needed.
**Transportation**

* Manage relationship and requests with outside transit providers, this includes assisting clients with Paratransit enrollment and coordinating requests for Group Van services, including participation in stakeholder meetings.
* Maintain transportation manifests for multiple providers.
* Document unmet and untimely service in internal logs \& communicate with vendors in real time.
**Supply \& Vendor Management**

* Coordinate meal service with outside vendor to ensure accurate count of meals based on forecasted Enrichment Center attendance.
* Maintain adequate stock of program materials and supply and replenish proactively.
**Other Duties**

* Participate in daily team meetings to inform Enrichment Center staff of the anticipated daily attendance and other details regarding prospects and other visitors.
* Assist Program Director in audit readiness and ongoing monitoring tasks to ensure compliance with state licensing regulations and other service contracts.
* Maintain knowledge of all safety and emergency protocols to effectively direct staff, clients, and visitors.
* Support Enrichment Center programs, including meals and activities, as needed.
* Actively participate in Companioa and IOA meetings.
* Other duties as assigned.
**EDUCATION:**


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

**BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Five years of program or administrative experience
* Interest and ability to support older adults, particularly persons with dementia
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Ability to maintain effective relationships with a wide range of internal and external clients
* Team player
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Computer proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to lift 35 lbs
* Ability to reach, bend and walk
**COMPENSATION:**

**Range:** $ 34 \- 35\.50/hourly

*This amount is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of any specific pay for any specific employee, which is always dependent on actual experience, education and other factors.*

*This range does not include any additional equity, benefits, or other non\-monetary compensation which may be included.*

jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



Join Anthropic's Customer Success team in a high\-visibility \& high\-impact role driving AI adoption across a small number of enterprise accounts in our Enterprise Tech segment. As our dedicated Customer Success Manager for Enterprise Tech Customers you’ll be their partner and trusted advisor helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities \- API, Claude Code, Cowork, and other surface areas.



You'll work with a book of global technology leaders to actively deploy AI and reshape the technology landscape. You’ll be working with key partners who are moving fast and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with LLM technology. Your role will entail developing genuine partnerships with the customer and key stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of their multi\-pronged business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us.



In partnership with the broader account team, you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives, working closely with them to provide best practices and guidance while supporting them as their usage grows and evolves.



Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, drive model and use case optimizations, implement change management strategies, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go\-to\-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business.


**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


* Build trusting, strategic relationships with key customer decision makers in complex, matrixed organizations; understand their business and objectives and identify opportunities for optimization and expansion
* Own customer operations across the lifecycle of each account, maintaining a structured operational assessment (customer readiness, operational health, strategic alignment, enablement strategy, adoption intelligence) that grounds comprehensive account and success plans and Executive Business Reviews
* Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude Code and Cowork, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions
* Leverage your deep knowledge of each customer, and the patterns you see across your other Tech accounts, to proactively drive consumption planning and the value story behind it, developing credible ROI hypotheses and quantifying outcomes that build the case for continued and expanded investment.
* Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities across Claude surface areas (API, Claude Code, Cowork) to drive full value from contracted commitments
* Serve as the customer’s thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic’s product roadmap, driving awareness on new products and engaging Product PMs
* Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end\-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement
* Ruthlessly prioritize across the account's many business units and workstreams, building programmatic, repeatable motions

**You may be a good fit if you have:**
--------------------------------------


* 6\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, or Strategy Consulting
* Experience working with F500 technology companies, SaaS platforms, or digital\-first businesses at the exec level—ideally including high\-growth and established tech companies.
* You understand what it means to lead organization\-wide change or adoption programs (multiple functions, hundreds of users) for a product that requires C\-suite sponsorship
* Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns across a set of diverse stakeholders—from developers and product managers to executives and end users
* Proven track record managing a portfolio of accounts while maintaining strong relationships and driving measurable outcomes — you can run multiple enterprise motions in parallel without letting any account go quiet.
* Cross\-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs
* Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems. You have built with Claude Code, automating your own workflows with agents, skills, and tooling.
* A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality

* Oct 1 – Oct 31: Mon – Fri, 9am – 5pm

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis starting **September 26 2026**.

**Position Summary**


The Glowfari Operations Manager supports the safe, guest\-ready operation of Glowfari, Oakland Zoo’s signature nighttime program. Serving as onsite manager during event hours, this role monitors event readiness, guest flow, lanterns, lighting, music, signage, rides, restricted areas, weather impacts, and site conditions. This hands\-on, cross\-functional role also handles elevated guest service issues, operational troubleshooting, service recovery, and emergency response coordination. This seasonal position begins in early September and runs through post\-event closeout in late February.

* Ensure vendors meet safety and operational standards throughout the Glowfari program.
* Identify and escalate repair needs early to allow vendors and/or internal teams time to resolve issues before program opening whenever possible.

*Onsite Management \& Leadership*

* Serve as the manager on duty during Glowfari hours, providing oversight and handling any elevated service issues that may arise.

* Provide targeted operational support to high\-demand areas, including train, gondola, rides, admissions, parking, and guest\-entry points, with particular attention to queue management, line closure communication, signage, and guest expectation\-setting.
* Document key issues, guest feedback, operational needs, and nightly updates in the appropriate communication channel to support continuity, follow\-up, and leadership visibility.

jobs.title: Compliance Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Why Socure?**
---------------


Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.


We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

**Compliance Operations Manager**
=================================

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


The line between compliance and technology is disappearing. Financial institutions no longer treat AML programs as a checkbox exercise — they are demanding platforms that embed regulatory intelligence directly into their screening, monitoring, and investigation workflows. Socure is building that platform, and we are looking for a Compliance Operations Manager to be the compliance mind behind it.


This role sits at the center of a four\-way intersection: the evolving regulatory landscape, our product and technology teams, our go\-to\-market motion, and our customers' compliance programs. You will be the compliance partner to engineering and data science, developing the rigorous frameworks, taxonomies, and methodologies that power the context layer underlying our AML platform and features. As regulations evolve — across OFAC, FATF, FinCEN, and international equivalents — you will translate that landscape into product strategy and help shape what Socure builds next.

As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

**Abode Property Management,** one of the largest and effective nonprofits working to end homelessness in the Bay Area, is seeking a Regional Property Operations Supervisor to oversee supportive housing communities within Santa Cruz, Santa Clara, and San Mateo Counties, and South Bay Subregions.

Our mission is to solve homelessness through housing and supportive services that help individuals and families achieve stability and independence. Grounded in the Housing First model, we meet people where they are and provide individualized support based on their needs, goals, and strengths. When you join Abode, you’re not just taking a job, you’re becoming part of a team creating meaningful change in our communities and a commitment to lasting housing stability.

jobs.title: Hospital Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
---------------



GoodVets is a nationwide network of modern animal hospitals, co\-owned with local veterinarians who are passionate about delivering gold\-standard care. We sit at the intersection of quality\-first medicine and people\-first culture, providing a supportive, growth\-minded environment for our teams—and unparalleled service for today's pet parents.


**The Opportunity:**
--------------------



As our Hospital Operations Manager, you'll be the operational heartbeat of the hospital. You'll run day\-to\-day, ensuring your team meets and exceeds performance, financial, and client\-experience targets. From staffing and scheduling to inventory, compliance, and reporting, you're the leader who makes the hospital run smoothly with a culture that attracts top talent and delivers exceptional veterinary care and patient experiences.

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Ensure compliance with all operating standards and requirements
* Create and maintain accurate work schedules
* Hire, train, and onboard new team members—setting the bar for performance and culture

* Conduct performance reviews and provide coaching for growth
* Monitor inventory, manage ordering, and maintain cost control

Support doctors, staff, and clients with clarity, speed, and professionalism  
* 

**Our Hospital Managers Bring:**

* **Operational Excellence:** Ability to execute and enforce protocols, manage appointment flow, oversee inventory, and balance hands\-on tasks with leadership responsibilities

* **Team Leadership:** Hires and develops high\-performing teams; models accountability and professionalism

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------


* Proven work experience as a Hospital Operations Manager, Medical Office Manager or similar role strongly preferred.
* Three plus years in veterinary medicine with progressive responsibilities, technician background strongly preferred
* Powerful leadership skills and an empathetic approach to management, experience training and mentoring/developing others
* Advanced skills in Practice Management Systems and MS Excel.
* Basic accounting skills
* Demonstrated ability to implement and enforce standard operating procedures and hospital protocols to maximize productivity and patient satisfaction
* Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and effectively with hospital and corporate teams and the confidence to make important decisions.

**What We Offer Our Hospital Managers:**

Join a company that invests in you and your future. At GoodVets, you're not just managing a hospital—you're shaping the standard for veterinary care.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, DashMart - Supply Chain Profitability Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



Our New Verticals Strategy \& Operations team is re\-inventing the way consumers think about grocery, convenience, alcohol and retail delivery through both our first\-party and third\-party operations businesses. DashMarts are our first\-party offering designed to provide on\-demand deliveries by selling household essentials, groceries, brand\-name favorites, local favorites and so much more. The end to end DashMart experience is powered through DoorDash. Third\-party partnerships enable us to offer on\-demand deliveries from both SMB and enterprise merchants across grocery, convenience alcohol and retail storefronts. The merchants own the inventory, we fulfill and deliver them!


**About the Role**
------------------



We are hiring an Associate Manager to join the DashMart Strategy \& Operations organization, focused on reducing supply chain costs to fuel profitability. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end effort to reduce shrink, using SQL and AI to analyze data and identify opportunities, then designing and implementing solutions from the ground up. Solutions may be process\-driven, working closely with Ops, Supply Chain, Vendor Management, and Category, or product\-driven, partnering with Product and Engineering teams to build scalable fixes. You will be goaled directly against a key profitability metric, making this a highly visible role with outsized impact on the bottom line.



We're looking for someone with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills who can think outside the box to uncover non\-obvious opportunities and creative solutions. You should bring a high degree of ownership and be comfortable independently driving a project from data analysis through cross\-functional execution. This role sits at the intersection of operations, product, and finance, and is critical to DashMart's profitability goals.



You will report into a Manager within the DashMart team. We operate in a hybrid work model with opportunities for in\-person collaboration a few times a year, and all our offices are open should you choose to go in on a more regular basis! All employees that work on DashMart are also expected to spend time understanding the operation on site.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* **Strategize**. You'll set financial goals for Shrink in both the short and long term, and create the playbook to achieve those goals.
* **Analyze**. You'll assess financial opportunity and operational impacts of your decisions across the entire business, and iterate based on data.
* **Build**. You'll own the implementation of your strategies end to end, from documenting processes and requirements to measuring the success of the results.
* **Scale**. You'll transform analytical insights into operational experiments that create measurable and scalable improvements to profitability.
* **Lead and collaborate**. You'll influence a cross\-functional team including category management, vendor management, central operations, product, engineering, and finance to solve problems and scale solutions.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* **You have subject matter expertise in** process improvement, data modeling, supply chain, and strong financial and business acumen.
* **You're equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and 1 foot.** You don't hesitate to get in the weeds with SQL and data analysis, but you're just as comfortable influencing roadmap discussions and strategic priorities.
* **You're unafraid of undefined processes.** You are a creative problem solver who's proficient at defining net new processes. You excel at working with a diverse group of people.
* **You're analytical.** You have a strong analytical background, advanced SQL proficiency, and experience with analytical visualization tooling (Sigma, Mode, Tableau, etc.). You have past experience building SQL queries from scratch and leveraging insights to drive business decisions.
* **You are AI native.** You think systematically about where AI can make your work better and have used AI tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini, etc. to enhance, refine and deepen your workflows.
* **You have 4\-6\+ years of experience.** You've succeeded at expanding businesses (whether in tech, retail, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or a related experience).
* You have completed your BS/BA Degree ideally in supply chain, business, economics, engineering or a related field.

**About DoorDash**
------------------



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  

  

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.


**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------



We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.description:
### **Company Description**


**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**


Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world\-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.


Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi\-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.


### **Job Description**


We have an opening for an **ESH Business \& Technology Enablement Lead**. In this role, you will gather and translate ESH business and information technology requirements, serve as a liaison between LivIT and ESH business owners, and apply strong project management skills to transform business needs into actionable, sustainable IT solutions. You will support solution evaluation, design, testing, implementation, user adoption, and sustainment, helping ensure that new solutions are effectively understood and used across affected ESH programs and user groups. A strong background and demonstrated experience in ESH operations will be essential as you collaborate across ESH, LivIT, and partner organizations to support project execution and application implementation. This position is within the Operations Department of the Environment Safety \& Health (ESH) Directorate.


*This position may offer a hybrid schedule, which includes the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week, after a probationary period. The specifics of the hybrid schedule, including the exact number of days required in the office and virtual work options may vary based on the needs of the team and the organization.*


**You will:**


* Apply knowledge of ESH programs, operations, and compliance requirements to gather, analyze, and translate ESH business needs into clear, actionable, and testable IT requirements that support effective solution development and implementation.
* Serve as a liaison between ESH business owners, LivIT, data specialists, and partner organizations to communicate requirements and support solution evaluation, design, testing, implementation, adoption, and sustainment.
* Lead efforts to analyze current\-state processes, identify gaps and root causes, and develop clear process maps and future\-state improvements for the IT portfolio.
* Utilize project management skills to lead highly complex ESH Application Management\-related projects, including project definition, planning, scheduling, risk management, stakeholder engagement, execution, implementation, monitoring, and closeout.
* Facilitate user acceptance, training, communications, and adoption activities to help ensure that implemented technology solutions are effectively understood and used across affected ESH programs and user groups.
* Support the administration and execution of the ESH Software Review Board to ensure the effective evaluation, prioritization, and approval of proposed information technology\-related business and functional requirements for software changes, workflows, dashboards, reports, and other technology\-enabled solutions, in coordination with appropriate business and technical stakeholders.
* Represent ESH in both institutional and departmental AI initiatives by coordinating business input, identifying practical use cases, and defining requirements, data needs, risks, and measures of success.
* Work in conjunction with the Business Architect to facilitate working sessions and provide concise briefings to ESH leadership on requirements, project status, risks, technology needs, adoption, and opportunities for improvement.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications**


* Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. Department of Energy Q\-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, physical science, or other ESH related field, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Substantial knowledge of, or experience with, ESH programs, operations, compliance functions, or related technical organizations, within a regulated, research and development, Department of Energy (DOE), National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA), or national laboratory environment.
* Substantial experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and translating business needs into clear, actionable, and testable information technology requirements including data, workflow, reporting, dashboard, and application requirements.
* Experience partnering with IT organizations to evaluate, implement, improve, or sustain business applications and technology\-enabled solutions.

**Responsibilities**

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**Our Mission:** **Hospital\-Quality Care, Everywhere.**
========================================================


The healthcare industry still relies on faxes and phone tags to coordinate critical care for patients at home. We think patients and the clinicians who serve them deserve better than a system stuck in 1995\.


Verse Medical is building the modern software infrastructure to make it happen. We're a well\-funded Series C company (backed by General Catalyst, SignalFire, and Sapphire Ventures) on a mission to heal a fragmented system. Our platform connects the dots between providers, payors, and patients, ensuring people get the high\-quality care they need, reliably and right where they live. We’re growing fast and looking for people who are driven by this mission to join us!

**Our Values:** **The Principles That Guide Us**
================================================


Our values are the operating system for how we work together and with our partners. They aren't just words on a wall; they are the principles we bring to every decision, every day.

* **We are transparent, upfront and direct.** We operate with honesty and clarity. We share information openly, the good and the bad, and believe that direct, respectful feedback is the foundation of trust and progress.
* **We value speed of iteration.** We are building something new, which means we learn by doing. We prioritize rapid iteration and getting solutions into the hands of users, believing that progress is more valuable than perfection.
* **We give 110% effort, 30% of the time.** We are passionate about our mission, and there are moments that require us to go the extra mile. We believe in focused intensity when it counts, balanced by a sustainable pace that keeps our team energized for the long run.
* **We empathize with customers to a fault.** When our users face a problem, we own it. Instead of asking them to change, we ask ourselves, *"How can we make this better?"* We believe true innovation comes from deep empathy and a relentless focus on solving the real\-world challenges of healthcare.

**Your Impact: How You'll Help Us Heal a Broken System**
--------------------------------------------------------


This is a rare opportunity to join a small but mighty team in a broad, high\-ownership role. The S\&O team's work is both internal and externally focused. We untangle cross\-team coordination problems, design and own the operational processes that allow our company to scale, but also sometimes represent Verse externally when a partnership or deal calls for it.


You'll report to the Head of Strategy \& Operations and work closely with functional leaders across Partnerships, Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and Product.

**What You'll Achieve: A Glimpse into Your Contributions**
----------------------------------------------------------


The specific initiative you're staffed on will shift over time, but your contributions will generally fall into a few recurring shapes of work:

* Cross\-functional coordination on high\-stakes, cross\-cutting initiatives: situations where multiple teams each own a piece of the puzzle and the work only succeeds if someone drives alignment and follow\-through across all of them (e.g., regulatory, compliance, or audit\-driven work)
* End\-to\-end program management for complex, high\-visibility deployments: running the project plan and owning the outcome, whether that's a major customer or partner implementation, or an initiative requiring close, sustained partnership with Engineering, Product, and Design
* Quantitative modeling and strategic analysis: building the financial or operational models that underpin major company decisions, from resourcing to strategic finance questions
* Revenue\-adjacent strategy and execution: go\-to\-market strategy in close partnership with Sales, and leading Verse's side of RFPs and similar competitive or procurement processes
* Incubating new functions from scratch: taking a "this doesn't exist yet, but we need it" problem and building the team, process, or capability that solves it, from initial design through steady\-state operation


This role comes with great responsibility \- we absolutely love what we do here at Verse and have a healthy culture, but you can expect this role and our expectations to be fairly rigorous.

**What You'll Bring: The Skills and Experience You'll Leverage**
----------------------------------------------------------------


We believe diverse backgrounds lead to better solutions. If you believe you can deliver the outcomes above, we encourage you to apply even if your path here looks different from what's listed.

### **Core Skills \& Experience**

* 4\+ years in a banking, consulting, startup, or otherwise rigorous role
* First\-principles thinking: in most cases, the work we're doing has fundamentally never been done before, at Verse or elsewhere. You should be able to construct solutions from scratch.
* Quantitative and analytical skills: all of our team members are expected to have solid numerical instincts and modeling skills
* Partnerships and sales: all of our team members should expect to carry the baton in some external relationship at some point, whether they're selling something to a customer, selecting and negotiating with vendors, or project managing a new partnership launch.
* Implementation and execution: the best team members not only produce insights, recommendations, strategies, but do whatever it takes to make sure these actually come to life. This usually requires a bias for quick action rather than slow and polished deliverables.
* Comfort with "spike" work: our workload isn't evenly paced — you flex your hours and effort to match real demand, surging when the team hits a crunch, a live issue, or a time\-sensitive push, and settling back into a sustainable pace once it passes

**The Rewards \& Reality: Compensation, Benefits \& Logistics**
-------------------------------------------------------

jobs.description:
* Sunnyvale, CA, United States
* Not Remote
* Administration
* JOB219134


  
### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic\-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


Were a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


The Fluorescence Imaging Team at Intuitive is developing agents designed to work seamlessly with Intuitive’s robotic platforms and Firefly imaging technology. The agents have the potential to highlight critical anatomy and disease in real time—giving surgeons clearer information at the moment decisions matter most and helping improve outcomes for patients.


If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position**


The Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance (RAQA) Project Manager serves as a strategic project management partner to Regulatory Affairs \& Quality Assurance leadership, with integrated project management responsibility for regulatory strategy execution and quality\-assurance readiness across development programs. The role translates regulatory strategies, health authority requirements, quality\-system obligations, and technical decisions into coordinated cross\-functional plans from clinical development through marketing application submission, approval, launch readiness, and post\-approval lifecycle management.


Reporting to the Program Management \& Operations organization, the RAQA Project Manager partners closely with Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC), Clinical Development, Clinical Development \& Operations, Biostatistics, Medical Writing, Pharmacovigilance, Supply Chain, Commercial, Legal, and external partners. The position places primary emphasis on regulatory planning, submission execution, health authority engagement, regulatory commitments, and inspection and compliance readiness, while integrating associated Quality Assurance activities into unified project plans.


**Roles and Responsibilities**


* Partner with Regulatory Affairs leadership to translate global and U.S. regulatory strategies into executable plans, including submission pathways, content plans, review timelines, decision points, dependencies, and resource requirements.


* Develop, maintain, and communicate integrated regulatory project plans for assigned programs, covering investigational and marketing applications, amendments, annual reports, meeting requests and briefing packages, responses to health authority information requests, labeling activities, regulatory commitments, and post\-approval submissions.


* Drive cross\-functional planning and operational execution for New Drug Application (NDA) submissions, including integrated content plans across Modules 1 through 5, document authoring and review workflows, publishing and submission\-readiness milestones, critical\-path management, and final filing activities.


* Coordinate regulatory deliverables across Regulatory Affairs, CMC, Clinical, Nonclinical, Quality Assurance, Product Launch, and external partners, ensuring owners, due dates, dependencies, and acceptance criteria are clearly defined.


* Plan and facilitate health authority interactions by coordinating meeting strategy, supporting briefing\-package development, question\-and\-answer preparation, rehearsals, meeting logistics, minutes, commitments, and post\-meeting action tracking.


* Maintain regulatory RAID and decision logs, submission trackers, correspondence logs, commitment registers, and governance materials; proactively identify risks to submission quality, completeness, timing, approvability, or regulatory compliance and facilitate mitigation plans.


* Coordinate responses to health authority questions and requests for information by establishing response teams, timelines, review and approval pathways, source\-document traceability, and readiness checkpoints.


* Support regulatory intelligence and impact assessments by tracking relevant guidance, precedents, policy changes, and agency feedback, and translating potential impacts into program actions, decision requests, and schedule updates.


* Integrate Quality Assurance activities that support regulatory execution, including inspection readiness, audit and inspection commitments, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) tracking, deviation and change\-control dependencies, document\-control requirements, and Good Practice (GxP) compliance deliverables.


* Partner with Quality Assurance and functional leaders to coordinate inspection\-readiness plans, mock inspections, evidence\-room and document requests, subject\-matter\-expert preparation, response tracking, and remediation follow\-through.


* Facilitate RAQA governance by preparing decision\-focused materials, documenting decisions and actions, monitoring follow\-through, and escalating unresolved risks, resource constraints, and cross\-functional conflicts through appropriate governance forums.


* Develop dashboards and executive reporting that communicate submission readiness, milestone performance, critical\-path status, health authority interactions, regulatory risks, quality\-readiness indicators, commitments, and decisions required.

jobs.title: Partner 20, Program Manager, Global Partnerships
jobs.description:
Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth\-stage technology companies, across AI, bio \+ healthcare, consumer, crypto, enterprise, fintech, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B\+ under management across multiple funds.



We've established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company\-building process; we know what it's like to be in the founder's shoes. We've invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.


**The Role**
------------



We are looking for a Program Manager to drive execution across the Global Partnerships team. This role will manage roadshows and LP engagements, coordinate GP and LP availability, and lead projects that span the team. The ideal candidate brings structure to complex logistics, keeps stakeholders and priorities aligned, and ensures that commitments, deliverables, and follow\-ups move forward on time.



The ideal candidate is exceptionally organized, anticipates needs before they are voiced, exercises sound judgment with highly sensitive information, and thrives in a fast\-moving, high\-stakes environment. You see around corners, sweat the details, and operate with a sense of ownership over outcomes, not just tasks.



We are open to candidates based in the San Francisco Bay Area. This role requires an in\-office presence and flexibility to support travel and time\-sensitive needs.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


**Roadshows and GP/LP Engagement**


* Manage roadshows and LP events from planning through execution, including schedules, venues, accommodations, transportation, security, briefing materials, and day\-of logistics
* Coordinate GP and LP availability across multiple stakeholders, locations, and time zones, proactively resolving conflicts and schedule changes
* Drive the LP engagement cadence by maintaining the engagement calendar and CRM, tracking meetings and commitments, and ensuring timely follow\-up
* Coordinate and host LP experiences, ensuring each visit is polished, welcoming, and consistent with the a16z brand
* Drive LP\-related deliverables, including fundraising milestones, DDQs, and data\-room requests, by managing timelines, coordinating inputs, and guiding materials through review and approval across multiple stakeholders


**Team Programs and Projects**


* Drive cross\-team projects from kickoff through completion, establishing work plans, timelines, owners, and clear deliverables
* Lead working sessions, track decisions and action items, and keep contributors aligned and accountable
* Manage recurring team workflows, templates, and trackers, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and consistency
* Maintain visibility into team priorities, dependencies, and commitments, surfacing risks and conflicts before they affect execution
* Take on additional strategic and operational projects based on the team's evolving priorities

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


* 5\-8\+ years in operations, program management, or supporting senior executives in a fast\-paced environment (e.g., venture capital, finance, professional services, or high\-growth tech), with meaningful exposure to complex logistics
* Proven track record managing complex multi\-city travel and high\-stakes external events from planning through flawless execution
* Exceptional organizational skills and obsessive attention to detail; able to manage many moving parts simultaneously without dropping a thread
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the polish and judgment to interface directly with LPs, senior leaders, and external partners
* Strong project management ability, with the range to take initiatives from 0 to 1, set timelines, and drive them to completion with minimal oversight
* Sound judgment and absolute discretion when handling confidential and sensitive information
* Comfort with ambiguity and a high rate of change; able to re\-prioritize quickly without compromising quality
* Proficiency with modern productivity, scheduling, and travel tools

**Ideal Candidate Background**
------------------------------


* You have a sense of urgency and value the courtesy of professional responsiveness (this is super important as speed is a form of client service)
* You anticipate needs and solve problems before they become problems; you see around corners
* You are able to adapt on the fly and handle unforeseen developments with ease, without compromising attention to detail and quality
* You strive to be an enabler who gives the leader and the team maximum leverage; there is no job too big, no job too small
* You do what you say you are going to do, when you say you are going to do it
* You continually search for new ideas and means of improvement
* You have low ego, high empathy, and the capacity to collaborate effectively
* Most importantly, you take your work seriously but not yourself too seriously


The anticipated salary range for this role is between $222,000 \- $259,000, actual starting pay may vary based on a range of factors which can include experience, skills, and scope.



This role is eligible to participate in the a16z carry program and various discretionary bonus programs as well as benefit and perquisite plans including health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401K plan, vacation, and sick leave.

**a16z culture**
----------------


* We do only first class business and only in a first class way
* We take a long view of relationships, because we are in the relationship business
* We believe in the future and bet the firm that way
*

**The Company**


Halo Industries has invented a revolutionary technology to replace a decades\-old semiconductor material slicing process. Our laser\-based technology eliminates waste, improves material cost and performance, and drives advancements in high\-growth markets like automotive, telecommunications, and power electronics. Founded in 2014 at Stanford University, Halo is well\-funded and poised for rapid growth, engaging strategic customers and preparing for volume manufacturing.

**The Opportunity**


The evolution of Halo’s technology and equipment, growing from an R\&D focus to a production manufacturing environment, has triggered the need for a Sr. NPI Project Manager who can help to coordinate the successful transition of its equipment manufacturing from the R\&D engineering team to the NPI equipment build team.

**Job Description**


The Sr. NPI Project Manager will coordinate the transfer of equipment build responsibilities to the NPI team and the timely and successful deployment of that equipment into production. Responsibilities include:

* Manage detailed project schedules, risk registers, and status reports for equipment builds
* Define project deliverables for NPI engineers, allocate and track tasks, and closely monitor progress
* Proactively identify and overcome obstacles to timely delivery of equipment and knowledge transfer. This requires hands\-on, detailed involvement in the daily work of the NPI engineering team.
* Coordinate cross\-functional collaboration to transfer knowledge, processes, and documents between the R\&D engineering and NPI teams
* Manage the NPI technical writing team’s development of all documents required for this transfer
* Drive PLM phase gate readiness for product design and production release
* Aid in determining the product or system requirements
* Drive continuous improvement in NPI processes, equipment, and tooling
* Coordinate the bringup of NPI equipment in halo’s international volume fabrication facilities
* Present project status to the Halo management team and participate in strategic planning activity

  

**Requirements** **Education \& Experience**

* A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Material Science, Physics, or related discipline
* A minimum of 4 years of NPI project management experience for complex engineering systems, preferably in the semiconductor industry
* Experience transitioning products from prototype to production/manufacturing scale
* Experience leading teams comprising 5 to 10 NPI engineers

**What We’re Looking For**

* High proficiency with modern project management tools and collaborative productivity tools
* Strong detail\-oriented organizational skills
* Strong technical communication skills with the capability to lead and collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team and communicate status to all stakeholders
* Ability to work effectively in a highly dynamic environment where priorities and schedules are subject to change
* Ownership mentality, with ability to work independently with minimal supervision
* Ability to build and sustain cooperative working relationships with managers, colleagues, and external partners
* Familiarity with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems

**Bonus**

* Experience with Arena PLM, Jira, Confluence, and Google Workspace applications (particularly Google Sheets)
* Project management certification (e.g., PMP)
* Experience in startup environments

  

**Benefits** ***Benefits***

* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D)
* Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
* Free Food \& Snacks
* Stock Option Plan
* Annual Bonus Plan eligible
* Short Term \& Long Term Disability

***Additional Information***


We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all team members feel valued and supported. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, including those from underrepresented communities in STEM. If you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.


Base salary range: $140k \- $160k

jobs.title: Legal Project Coordinator (Part-Time 15 hours)
jobs.description:
Join a nonprofit organization dedicated to improving our community through programs that provide equal access to legal services. The Justice \& Diversity Center of The Bar Association of San Francisco (JDC) has an exciting opportunity for a part\-time **Legal Project Coordinator** to be part of the team!

**About JDC**

JDC is a non\-profit organization which provides free legal services through its staff and volunteers to low\-income Bay Area residents. Each year more than 1,600 volunteer attorneys, legal assistants, and law students work with JDC staff to serve nearly 7,500 indigent clients. JDC’s holistic advocacy approach seeks to address the social service and legal needs of clients.

**About the Job** 

The Legal Project Coordinator will work with JDC’s Federal Pro Bono Project, reporting to and working with the Supervising Attorney and Senior Staff Attorney. The Federal Pro Bono Project assists self\-represented litigants in two ways: (1\) staff attorneys at Legal Help Centers in the San Francisco and Oakland federal courthouses provide legal advice and guidance on federal civil cases; and (2\) the Project matches litigants with volunteer attorneys to represent them in their cases.

This is a part\-time position working 15 hours per week. Working hours are flexible so long as they occur during regular workdays and are consistent week\-to\-week. The position is fully remote, but office space is available at JDC’s downtown location should the successful candidate prefer to work some or all of their hours in a more social setting.

As the first point of contact for litigants communicating with the Project, the Coordinator is a critical part of the Project team. The Coordinator’s primary responsibilities are to conduct intakes and screening by phone and email, and to schedule appointments with the Project attorneys when appropriate. The Coordinator uses strong communication and organizational skills to keep the Project’s Legal Help Center legal advice work on track and ensure that litigants eligible for assistance are scheduled in a timely manner. The Coordinator also assists with outreach, database upkeep, development of resources, and improvement of best practices.

**Education \& Experience:**

· Relevant education, training, and experience to perform the essential duties of the position

· Experience in the legal field is helpful but not required

**Skills \& Requirements:**

· Professional verbal and written communication skills

· Ability to interact with clients courteously and with cultural humility

· Efficient self\-starter with strong organization and time management skills

· Careful attention to detail

· Proficient in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams)

· Demonstrated interest in working with low\-income communities

· Bilingual language skills are a plus

**Why Work For Us** 

The Project team offers a small, supportive work environment within a larger organization and the opportunity to collaborate with a progressive work culture. Additionally, we are a mission and values\-based organization.

To find out more about JDC, please visit our website at www.sfbar.org/jdc

Please submit your resume along with cover letter**.**

They will oversee program operations, including personnel, financial and physical resources, simulation technology, policies and procedures, program evaluation, and performance metrics. This includes programs conducted at all BCH Oakland sites, as well as simulation\-based outreach programs. They will collaborate with the BCH Medical Director of Simulation, the Clinical Nurse Simulation Educator, and other key stakeholders, including but not limited to quality and patient safety leaders, simulation leads and educators, and other system leaders, to assess needs, develop innovative simulation\-based programs, and support their implementation. Support will include activities such as calendar planning and maintenance; working with simulation leaders on programmatic expansion and quality improvement, including outreach programs; managing the budget; tracking outcome measures; overseeing equipment storage and maintenance; and resource allocation. The Program Manager should be well\-versed in simulation methodology and may help facilitate front\-line simulation activities.


The ideal candidate is a talented professional with diverse life experiences and perspectives who has 5\+ years of experience in medical simulation—prior lead or supervisory experience required.


  
**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a related area and/or equivalent experience/training
* 3\+ years of directly relevant experience in simulation\-based education and technology
* 3\+ years of lead/supervisor/manager experience with demonstrated strategic planning and leadership skills in training and guiding employees on educational techniques. Motivates and inspires staff to improve the health profession education services
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize effectively to meet deadlines in a complex, challenging environment. Ability to organize assigned staff and unit operations in an efficient and effective manner.
* Effective communication skills (verbal and written) with peers, learners, faculty, and other education program coordinators/managers
* Skills to evaluate issues and identify solutions within defined procedures and policies. Demonstrated ability to solve problems and suggest solutions through the critical thinking process
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Knowledge of department, organization, HR and university policies and processes. Current knowledge of relevant industry federal, state and local laws and regulations including national accrediting organizations and state and federal licensing and regulatory offices
* Experience in quality and process improvement
* Master's degree in related area
* AHA PALS/ACLS Certification
* LEAN Certification

jobs.title: Bilingual (English/Spanish) Remote ABA Intake Coordinator
jobs.description:
Are you a self\-motivated, hands\-on individual looking to do something passionate and meaningful with your career? Join us as we open a world of possibilities.
We are currently seeking an **Intake Coordinator who is bilingual in English and Spanish** to join our dynamic and growing team!* Full\-Time, Non\-Exempt Position \- $25\-$32
* Remote \- PST Hours
* Bilingual in English and Spanish required
* Growth \& Development Opportunities

**Who we are:** The Center for Social Dynamics (CSD) is an organization providing services to those with developmental delays, including autism, in the state of California, Oregon, Washington and Hawaii.


CSD’s people and programs deliver personalized, professional, evidence\-based behavioral and developmental services to each participant, and peace of mind to caregivers that their loved ones are in the right hands and are receiving the best possible care.

**What is a Intake Coordinator?**

**Intake Coordinators** are responsible for managing the intake and referral process across the organization. They ensure timely and accurate processing of referrals, collect and verify all relevant client and authorization information, and serve as a key point of contact for clinicians, administrative staff, and funding sources. Intake Coordinators monitor the progress of assessments, support scheduling teams with treatment\-related details, and maintain accurate documentation in referral and EMR systems. They also contribute to the orientation of new staff, help improve intake systems and processes, and assist with additional administrative tasks as needed to support regional operations.

**What your role is:**

* Processes referrals sent to the organization daily in a timely manner
* Provides Regional Director/Clinician/Admin team with comprehensive intake data within same day of intake being completed to ensure a timely response
* Serves as resource to other staff in the area of intake and triage
* Assists administrative team (e.g., scheduling) in understanding patient referrals treatment indicated and/or requested
* Participates in intake/triage orientation of new staff
* Responds to patient and non\-patient emergencies according to CSD policies and procedures.
* Obtains and enters all relevant client information from referral source to ensure information is appropriately verified and accurate organization wide
* Collects and enters authorization information into EMR system; appropriately assigns CPT and ICD\-9 codes when entering authorizations. Follows up with funding sources regarding missing authorizations in a timely manner.
* Reviews assessments for clerical mistakes before sending to the funding source
* Correctly identifies billing and documentation issues which need to be attended to by clinicians and managers and report them in a timely manner
* Answers inquiries from clinicians, clients and funding sources regarding authorizations, treatment/assessment status and services being offered; documents all interactions with clients
* Enters all relevant referral information to referral tracking systems for all referrals sent on a daily basis
* Utilizes referral tracking system to monitor and track referral process and assessment completion
* Tracks intakes requiring urgent attention and communicates difficulties to Regional Director or direct supervisor
* Creates and revises client\-intake and treatment systems and processes for all funding sources by analyzing current operating practices and by communicating directly with the funding sources
* Provides detailed information to scheduling, Regional Directors/Manager regarding client timelines to ensure accurate and timely provision of services
* Additional administrative tasks as determined by the needs of the organization.

**What’s required from you?**

* Associate’s degree from an accredited college or university or the equivalent of two years of college coursework at an accredited college or university.
* 3\-5 years of ABA intake required
* Bilingual in English and Spanish required
* Experience with CentralReach, Experience with CRM systems, High volume intake processes.
* Computer proficient in word processing, database, spreadsheet and Internet software programs.
* Able to professionally and effectively interact and communicate, verbally and in writing, with volunteers, staff, clients and a public from diverse cultural, socioeconomic, and disciplinary backgrounds. Strong editing skills.
* Able to work independently and as part of a team, take initiative, prioritize and accurately perform multiple tasks, and efficiently meet deadlines and changing priorities.
* Able to consistently demonstrate good judgment and decision\-making skills.
* Able to exercise confidentiality and discretion pertaining to the work environment.
* Able to appropriately interpret and apply policies and procedures.
* Familiar with the ABA field.
* Sensitive to working with an ethnically, linguistically, culturally, and economically diverse population.


,

**Benefits \& Perks**


You will have an opportunity to grow your career in this purpose\-filled industry where you can see results every day. Benefits include:

* Competitive, market pay based on experience, location, and skills
* Bonus eligibility
* Paid time off (PTO)
* 401k
* CSD issued devices
* Free college or tuition reimbursement through our Dreams Come True program


CSD is a proud equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.


Pursuant to applicable State and local laws, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

**About Our TRUE Values**

**Transparency** in the work that we do and the actions we take to achieve our mission. There are no hidden agendas or motives at Center for Social Dynamic

Overview:

An HR Coordinator is responsible for providing support to the human resources department in various administrative tasks. They assist with recruitment and onboarding processes, maintain employee records, handle employee inquiries, coordinate training programs, support benefits admin, leave administration, and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
Responsibilities:

Processes hires from recruitment to on\-boarding and prepares new hire documents and on\- boarding materials to ensure a smooth transition to employment.  

Submits candidate for background and reference checks, education and license verification, verifies completion of fingerprinting process and follows up with candidate/organization to ensure all necessary information is received and processed expeditiously.  

Coordinates and presents New Employee Orientation (NEO) agency\-wide and new hire on\- boarding activities; communicates with both the regional site\-liaisons and prospective supervisor(s) and employee regarding start date/on\-boarding expectations for new hires.  

Supports benefit and leave administration.  

Works across multiple systems providing support to employees and external candidates.  

Utilizes the Agency HRIS to record employee information and submits changes as required to ensure employees' records are accurate and complete. This includes, but is not limited to: new hire information, licenses, certifications, supervisor changes, positions changes, location changes, salary updates, etc.  

Maintains and cross\-trains on employee personnel file compliance including 19 Files and DMV records.  

Works closely with the Intern Department to insure Intern pre\-hire clearances are completed, conducts Intern on\-boarding and finalizes the Intern personnel files; closes the Intern files at the completion of Intern assignment.  

Works closely with Talent Acquisition Specialist (TAS) and temporary agencies to ensure required documents and clearances for temporary workers are received in a timely manner, schedules for on\-boarding temps are communicated to the hiring supervisor and assist with ensuring that temporary workers have required access; works with TAS to close temp file at the completion of assignment.  

Administers and cross\-trains on Rewards and Recognition programs, including maintaining records, reviewing invoices, ordering merchandise, managing delivery dates for monthly employee service awards, certificates, cash and gift card awards and flower requests.  

Administers and cross\-trains on employee programs including bilingual proficiency testing.  

Creates employee badges for Agency new hires and all employees.  

Participates in work groups with co\-workers to support desired departmental and organizational initiatives.  

Assists in preparing for state, county and local audits.  

Ensures timely departmental pick up of incoming and outgoing mail and emails.  

Communicates effectively in a culturally competent and diverse consumer population and promotes favorable interaction with managers, co\-workers and other  

Supports project completion, and is responsible for handling and directing communications with both internal and external customers in a professional, efficient and organized fashion.  

Models Pacific Clinics' approach, mission and core values in all communication and correspondence.  

Performs other duties as assigned.
Qualifications:

Associates Degree (AA/AS) and (2\) two or more years of HR experience required, or combination of equivalent education and experience to include:  

Two (2\) years of HR clerical experience including intermediate to advanced knowledge of Microsoft Access, Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.  

Strong organizational and communication skills are essential for success in this role.

jobs.title: Customer Experience & Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**About ArtHaus Properties**### **The expanded ArtHaus Properties operating company is a wholly owned subsidiary of Arthaus Partners, purpose\-built to manage and scale our vertically integrated residential platform. This role offers a rare opportunity to help shape the future of operations at a company on the verge of doubling its footprint, bringing structure, innovation, and excellence to a portfolio with significant near\-term growth ahead. It’s an exciting moment to lead, build, and leave your mark.**

**Position Summary**
--------------------


ArtHaus Properties is seeking a Customer Experience \& Quality Manager to create a consistent, high\-quality resident experience across our portfolio.


This role owns the design, visibility, quality control and continuous improvement of the company’s Resident Request Resolution process. The manager ensures that every resident request is captured, assigned, monitored, communicated and properly closed—and that recurring failures are identified and corrected.


The role also provides independent quality control over the physical resident experience, including property appearance, common\-area conditions, move\-in readiness and other points where residents interact with an ArtHaus property.


Regional Managers and Property Managers remain accountable for resolving resident issues and delivering property\-level results. The Customer Experience \& Quality Manager owns the integrity and effectiveness of the process used to produce those results.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Resident Request Resolution Process**

* Own and continuously improve the companywide Resident Request Resolution workflow.
* Ensure resident requests from all approved channels enter the designated system of record.
* Establish consistent request categories, priority levels, response standards, resolution targets and escalation rules.
* Ensure every request has a named responsible person, required next action and target completion date.
* Monitor open, overdue, unassigned and high\-risk resident requests across the portfolio.
* Confirm that residents receive timely acknowledgment, status updates and resolution communications.
* Establish documentation and evidence requirements for closing resident requests.
* Audit closed requests to confirm that the underlying issue was resolved and communicated appropriately.
* Return incomplete or improperly closed requests for additional action.
* Escalate unresolved or repeatedly delayed matters to the appropriate Regional Manager and, when necessary, the President.
* Identify recurring complaints, process breakdowns and systemic service issues.

### **Customer Experience Standards**

* Develop and maintain ArtHaus standards for resident communication and service.
* Define the expected resident experience at critical touchpoints, including move\-in, maintenance requests, complaints, property notices and issue resolution.
* Review resident communications for clarity, professionalism, empathy, accuracy and consistency.
* Develop templates, playbooks and service\-recovery standards for common resident situations.
* Partner with operating leaders to provide training and coaching on customer\-experience expectations.
* Gather resident feedback and translate it into practical operational improvements.
* Identify situations in which an issue may be technically completed but the resident experience remains unresolved.

### **Physical Experience and Property Quality Control**

* Develop practical quality standards for the physical resident experience.
* Conduct scheduled and unannounced property\-quality reviews across the portfolio.
* Inspect resident\-facing areas, including building entrances, lobbies, hallways, elevators, laundry rooms, mail and package areas, trash areas, exterior conditions, signage and other common spaces.
* Review move\-in\-ready units from the resident’s perspective.
* Evaluate cleanliness, appearance, functionality, safety presentation and consistency with ArtHaus standards.
* Document deficiencies with photographs, ownership assignments and corrective\-action deadlines.
* Verify that identified deficiencies are corrected—not merely marked complete.
* Track recurring physical\-quality issues by property, region, category and responsible function.
* Coordinate with Regional Managers, Property Managers and Maintenance leadership while preserving their accountability for execution.
* Recommend improvements to inspection standards, property routines and preventive\-quality controls.

### **Quality Assurance and Process Control**

* Develop a risk\-based quality\-assurance program covering resident requests and physical property conditions.
* Audit a defined sample of open and closed resident requests each week.
* Monitor adherence to response, communication, documentation and closure standards.
* Identify workflow failures, unclear handoffs and requests that fall between departments.
* Conduct root\-cause reviews for recurring complaints, reopened cases and serious service failures.
* Facilitate corrective\-action plans with the responsible operating leader.
* Verify whether corrective actions produced sustained improvement.
* Maintain consistent quality standards across properties and regions.

### **Reporting and Performance Management**

* Build and maintain a portfolio\-level customer\-experience and quality scorecard.
* Report performance by property, region, request category and responsible function.
* Track key measures such as:
* + Percentage of requests captured in the system
	+ Percentage with a named owner and due date
	+ First\-response time
	+ Average resolution time
	+ Service\-level compliance
	+ Requests without timely resident updates
	+ Requests open longer than 3, 7, 14 and 30 days
	+ Reopened\-request rate
	+ Repeat complaints
	+ Resident\-confirmed resolution rate
	+ Resident satisfaction
	+ Request\-quality audit score
	+ Property\-quality inspection score
	+ Corrective acti

jobs.description:
Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?


**Transform the everyday with us!**


**We are looking for a Quality Assurance Manager.** The Quality Assurance Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing comprehensive quality assurance systems and procedures to ensure products, services, and processes consistently meet established quality standards, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations.



As a working manager, this role directly oversees, leads, and mentors the team of quality assurance engineers and managers within the QM\-QA department at the two Trayer Engineering site locations in the SF East Bay (San Leandro and Livermore). Key responsibilities include directing, training, and supervising these professionals, developing strategic quality initiatives, driving continuous improvement, and fostering a robust culture of quality throughout the organization by focusing on process excellence.


**This role will be based onsite in San Leandro and/or Livermore, CA.** *Local candidates are strongly encouraged to apply*. Relocation assistance may be available for eligible candidates. The East Bay offers an excellent quality of life with top\-rated schools, pleasant climate, and easy access to both mountains and the coast. Plus, your compensation goes further here with a more attainable cost of living compared to other parts of the San Francisco Bay Area. Enjoy the perfect blend of small\-city charm and big\-city access.

--------------------------------------------


* Develop, implement, and maintain the organization's Quality Management System (QMS)
* Formulate and implement quality strategies, policies, and procedures to ensure process and product quality.
* Define quality metrics, targets, and reporting mechanisms to monitor system performance and effectiveness.

-----------------------------------


* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Quality Engineers, Quality Managers and other quality professionals.

-------------------------------------------

* Ensure effective implementation of methodologies (e.g., SPC, pFMEA, Fishbone Analysis, 5 Why, PPAP, 8D) and quality tools to prevent defects and improve processes.

* Participate in all Product Safety related activities.
* Perform the duties as the level 3 review and approval for all Product Safety investigations and risk analysis
* Oversee communications and corrective actions with Mexico and Germany factories on customer issues

**Continuous Improvement:**
---------------------------


* Drive a culture of continuous improvement by promoting Lean, Six Sigma, and other methodologies to optimize processes, reduce variation, and prevent waste.
* Analyze KPI and quality data to identify trends, potential risks, and opportunities for process and system enhancement.
* Collect before and after delivery Non\-Conforming Cost (NCC) data and develop actions to reduce or eliminate them using 8D methodologies.
* Establish, lead and participate in cross\-functional teams to address systemic quality issues, eliminate non\-conformities, and implement lasting solutions.

jobs.title: Service Delivery Manager
jobs.description:
***About the role:***


The Service Delivery Manager oversees and develops audits, training, and emergency procedures for the JSOC. This position is directly responsible for delivering Key Performance Indicators and Service Level Agreements from the vendor to the purchaser. The Service Delivery Manager partners with client managers to develop the program's strategic direction. The Service Delivery Manager reviews after\-action reports and reports the findings to clients and stakeholders for appropriate action. The Service Delivery Manager works with the client to develop an annual strategic plan with goals listed by quarter and ensures that the JSOC attains them.

***In this role, your responsibilities will be:***

* Manage all facets of the vendor team
* Manage relationships with all personnel and the client manager
* Support leadership during critical incidents
* Ensure operational readiness for incident response in JSOC
* Define and direct projects associated with the JSOC, including training, testing, certification, etc.
* Oversees the development and compliance of training and certification programs
* Develop strategic initiatives to achieve high\-performance standards across all personnel.
* Report metrics and KPI data in accordance with the SOW.
