jobs.description:
**Reports To:** Client Services Supervisor, Client Services Manager, or equivalent leadership


**Schedule:** Monday–Friday \| 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM


### **Keep Operations Running Smoothly Behind the Scenes**



If you're hands\-on, organized, and thrive in a fast\-paced environment, this role is for you. As a **Client Services Associate**, you'll support daily office operations through mail handling, print services, and workplace coordination.



From managing deliveries to maintaining essential supplies, your work ensures the office runs efficiently and teams have what they need to stay productive.


### **Why This Role Matters**



This role plays a key part in maintaining the flow of daily operations. By ensuring accurate mail distribution, timely processing of requests, and well\-managed workspaces, you help create a reliable and efficient environment.


### **What You'll Do**


*Mail \& Shipping Operations*


* Receive, sort, and distribute **inbound mail and packages**.
* Process **outgoing shipments** using postage and shipping systems.
* Track deliveries and maintain accurate records using **scanning tools and tracking systems**.
* Respond to inquiries related to mail and package status.


*Print \& Office Support*


* Fulfill **basic print and document requests**.
* Provide light support for **copier equipment**, including toner replacement and upkeep.


*Workplace \& Inventory Support*


* Monitor and replenish **paper and office supplies in copy/mail areas**.
* Maintain **clean, organized mailrooms and service areas**.
* Assist with **meeting room setups, office moves, and workplace support** tasks as needed


*Operational Support*


* Communicate with employees regarding deliveries and service requests.
* Crosstrain across mailroom functions and support additional operational needs.
* Follow all **safety, security, and company procedures**.
* Assist with additional tasks as assigned.

### **What You Bring**


* Strong communication and customer service skills
* Ability to work independently and stay organized
* Familiarity with **shipping/receiving processes (preferred)**
* Comfort using **basic office systems and Microsoft Office**
* Hands\-on, reliable, and adaptable in adynamic environment

### **Qualifications**


* High school diploma or equivalent required
* 2\+ years of relevant experience preferred
* Experience with handheld scanners, pallet jacks, or carts (preferred)
* Ability to work assigned hours, including occasional overtime

* Health insurance, 401(K), PTO, clinic treatment discounts

jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.


Join Anthropic's Customer Success team in a high\-impact role driving AI adoption across our Commercial segment. As one of the first CSMs for our Commercial segment, you’ll be a thought partner both for our customers and for your cross\-functional partners, helping define how Customer Success can play the most meaningful role in helping our customers harness the full potential of our products, move toward the frontier, and ultimately realize value.



You'll work with organizations that move fast and push the boundaries of what's possible with AI, helping them harness the full potential of all of our Claude capabilities: from Claude Code and Cowork to the API. Drawing on both your business acumen and technical expertise, you’ll gain a deep understanding of customers’ business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey.



In partnership with the broader account team, you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives, providing best practices and guidance while supporting your customers as their usage grows and evolves.



Your role focuses on helping customers both scale and optimize their usage, implement change management strategies, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases and value realization measurements. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our product development and go\-to\-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a Commercial segment and broader business.


**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


* Build trusting, strategic relationships with key customer decision makers to understand their business and objectives, identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion
* Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude Code and Claude for Enterprise, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions
* Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities, proactively addressing underutilization across both consumption\-based (API) and seat\-based (Claude for Enterprise / Claude Code) products, developing activation plans for newly sold use cases, and mapping out future consumption / adoption opportunities to drive full value from contracted commitments
* Serve as the customer’s thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products and advancing their journey toward the frontier by socializing Anthropic’s product roadmap, driving awareness on new products, and engaging Product PMs
* Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end\-user adoption, including Champion Program development, Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and overall organizational enablement
* Document and quantify customer value realized through business outcomes, ROI, and impact metrics to build compelling internal business cases for continued and expanded investment
* Identify potential use cases and lines of business not currently onboarded, partnering with customers and Sales to discover new applications for Claude across different departments, teams, and workflows
* Own the customer experience across their lifecycle — managing comprehensive account and success plans grounded in the customer's business objectives, conducting Quarterly Business Reviews, and serving as the primary conduit between the customer and Anthropic
* Develop scalable engagement strategies and playbooks to optimize efforts across your portfolio and help fellow CSM’s scale their impact

  




**You may be a good fit if you have:**
--------------------------------------


* 4\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Solutions Engineering
* Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns across a set of diverse stakeholders — from developers and product managers to executives and end users
* Experience driving success across both consumption\-based and seat\-based business models, with understanding of different expansion levers and success metrics for each
* Strategic mindset to identify growth opportunities and translate them into actionable expansion plans
* Proven track record managing a portfolio of accounts while maintaining strong relationships and driving measurable outcomes
* Cross\-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs
* Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems
* A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality—you're a true team player

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager, API
jobs.description:
Perplexity's API Platform brings our work in AI, search, and agent orchestration to developers. Our customers range from AI\-native startups to some of the world's largest technology companies. Working with them, alongside our own developments in building Perplexity’s core application gives our team direct exposure to how search, models, and tools are used to build and scale AI\-native products and applications.


**About this role**
-------------------


We are looking for a technically fluent Customer Success Manager to help our API customers succeed and shape how we support them as the business grows. You will own a portfolio of customers, understand what they are building, and help them move from evaluation to production and broader adoption.


Alongside your accounts, you will lead projects such as product and endpoint migrations, customer enablement, and communications for product updates and incidents. You will work directly with customers developing AI products and with the engineers building the APIs they depend on. As an early member of the team, you will help shape our customer success programs and bring what you learn from customers into product decisions.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Own customer relationships across onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion, building trust with developers, technical leaders, and business stakeholders.
* Understand each customer's use case, integration, and success criteria. Help them evaluate the APIs, resolve adoption barriers, and establish a path to production.
* Use account and product usage data to identify declining adoption, technical risks, and growth opportunities, then work with customers on specific next steps.
* Investigate technical questions using API documentation, sample requests, and usage data. Coordinate with Engineering and Support on deeper issues and keep customers informed through resolution.
* Lead customer\-facing programs such as endpoint migrations, product rollouts, and enablement. Define milestones, coordinate internal owners, and track customer readiness and completion.
* Manage customer communications for product changes, deprecations, and outages, partnering with technical teams to provide accurate updates and clear guidance.
* Build and improve the API customer success playbook, including onboarding, account reviews, customer health signals, escalation paths, and sales\-to\-CS handoffs.
* Partner with Sales and account owners on renewals and expansion, using adoption, consumption, and business outcomes to demonstrate value and surface risks early.
* Bring customer feedback into product planning and work with Developer Relations and Support on documentation and enablement that address recurring needs.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


* 4\+ years of experience in customer success, technical account management, solutions engineering, or a related customer\-facing role at a technology company.
* Technical fluency: comfortable reading API documentation, making API requests, interpreting responses and errors, and discussing integration questions with developers.
* A track record of driving adoption, retention, or growth across a portfolio of customers, with clear ownership of follow\-through.
* Experience creating or improving a customer program, playbook, or cross\-functional process, not only operating an established one.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly and communicate carefully when facts are still developing.
* Sound judgment in balancing account needs with strategic projects, setting priorities, and moving work forward without a detailed brief.

**Nice to have**
----------------


* Experience with APIs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or usage\-based products.
* Familiarity with AI applications, search, retrieval, or agents, including how customers evaluate quality, latency, and cost.
* Working knowledge of Python or SQL for reproducing issues, analyzing usage, or automating recurring work.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============



Concert Health is the leading national behavioral health medical group committed to integrating the Collaborative Care model into existing health care practices to improve patients' lives. We believe everyone, regardless of location or insurance, should have easy access to personalized, high\-quality behavioral health support that is guided by the provider they trust.


### **Who You Are**



You are a seasoned account leader who is energized by depth over breadth — you'd rather go deep on a smaller portfolio of complex, high\-value accounts than manage a wide book with less context on each. You build real fluency in each partner's clinical operations, stakeholders, and goals, and you use that fluency as the foundation for everything else: faster issue resolution, sharper growth strategy, and smoother provider onboarding.



You're equally comfortable being hands\-on and thinking several moves ahead. Day to day, you're the named point of contact partners trust to resolve issues and keep commitments on track. At the same time, you're building the data\-backed case for why a partner should expand, and running the onboarding plan for the next provider joining the account — moving between all three without losing sight of the relationship that ties them together.



You bring the judgment and track record of someone with 9\+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, or Client Services in healthcare, with a career trajectory into progressively larger and more complex accounts. You've driven measurable growth in existing accounts (not just retention), ideally onboarded new sites, providers, or users into a live account, and you're credible in a room with C\-suite and senior clinical leadership. Beyond your own accounts, other Account Managers look to you for how the job should be done — you set the standard, not just meet it.


### **Job Summary**



The Key Account Manager owns the complete lifecycle of Concert Health's most strategic partnerships — day\-to\-day relationship management, long\-term account growth, and the onboarding of new providers within existing accounts. This is Concert Health's most advanced individual\-contributor role in Account Management: one person, accountable end\-to\-end for a focused portfolio of high\-value, high\-complexity accounts, trusted to move fluidly between hands\-on servicing, strategic growth planning, and program\-managed provider launches without ever dropping the relationship thread.


**Core Responsibilities:**


*Own Day\-to\-Day Partner Success \& Issue Resolution:*


* Serve as the primary, named point of contact for a focused portfolio of key accounts, ensuring timely, high\-quality responses across clinical, operational, and administrative needs
* Proactively identify, triage, and resolve issues – driving toward systematic, scalable solutions rather than one\-off fixes
* Coordinate cross\-functional resources (clinical, operations, product, billing) to remove barriers and maintain momentum within each account
* Establish clear accountability, follow\-through, and communication loops so nothing falls through the cracks for your accounts
* Maintain deep, current fluency in each key account's clinical operations, stakeholders, and performance, so day\-to\-day servicing and long\-term strategy are always working from the same picture


*Grow Key Accounts*


* Own overall account performance for your portfolio – clinical, operational, and financial – with direct accountability for growth, not just retention
* Use utilization, outcomes, and financial data to identify white\-space opportunities within each key account and translate them into a concrete growth plan
* Build and pitch data\-backed growth and expansion cases to partner leadership, framing clinical outcomes and financial performance into a compelling case for investment
* Translate partner goals into actionable success plans with clear milestones and measurable outcomes, and hold both internal teams and partners accountable to them
* Lead negotiations with partner stakeholders to convert growth opportunities into signed, executed expansion


*Manage Leadership \& Executive Relationships*


* Build and maintain strong, trust\-based relationships with executive sponsors and senior clinical stakeholders at each key account
* Lead regular business reviews, presenting performance insights, outcomes, and growth recommendations
* Confidently navigate complex, matrixed stakeholder environments, aligning priorities and driving decision\-making
* Act as a strategic advisor, influencing partner leadership to invest in and expand Collaborative Care as a core model across their organization


*Set the Standard for the Function*

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

Leading this team will challenge your ability to context\-switch from high level customer strategy to tactical account level escalations to retention opportunities on a daily basis. The ideal candidate is a customer\-obsessed strategist, eager to build and mentor a team of incredible TAMs.

	+ Constantly iterate and improve TAM workflows and optimize process inefficiencies
	+ Collaborate with leadership team on quarterly kickoffs, offsites, team building events, and more to foster a strong team culture

**What you will need**

jobs.description:
**About Lumafield:**

Lumafield was founded in 2019 to upgrade manufacturing.

We are engineers with deep experience across the product development cycle, from initial ideas to shipping hardware, across industries and specializations, who became frustrated by the cost and complexity of modern manufacturing. So we decided to upgrade it.

Engineers make million\-dollar decisions every day, and they need tools that give them the greatest possible insight into their products. By offering unprecedented visibility into products, as well as AI\-driven tools that highlight problems and generate quantitative data, Lumafield promises to revolutionize the way complex products are created, manufactured, and used across industries. We started with industrial CT scanning, which for us was the most valuable but underutilized tool in the manufacturing toolbox, enabling us to rapidly inspect essential components non\-destructively.

We rebuilt the whole system, from X\-ray capture, to computer vision analysis, to web\-based collaboration, to the entire business model, making the most advanced manufacturing tech more accessible to every industry. Our company, like our platform, is designed for upgrades. We’re building for greater intelligence, autonomy, and speed. For deeper vision, operational excellence, and powerful insights. And then we'll upgrade it all again.

Lumafield is headquartered in San Francisco, CA. and has an office in Cambridge, MA. **About the role:**

Lumafield is looking to bring on a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to partner closely with their customers, champion their needs internally, and manage accounts to achieve business outcomes and revenue growth.

Working at the intersection of advanced industrial technology, manufacturing, and customer strategy, CSMs will lead business reviews, develop and execute on mutual customer success plans, and drive net revenue retention through strategic account growth.The CSM will own the customer lifecycle from post\-sale onboarding through renewals and expansion, serving as the advisor and trusted partner for stakeholders, helping build advocacy within their accounts, and ensuring customers achieve business value from our products.

This role requires the technical depth to understand engineering analyses, as well as the business acumen to translate technical success into measurable business value and lead conversations with executive stakeholders at customer organizations.
### **What you’ll do:**

* Own the relationships, revenue, contracts, and outcomes associated with your accounts
* Partner with as trusted advisor to your customers, partnering with their engineering, quality, and operations teams to identify opportunities and advise on how to improve quality control, accelerate root cause analysis, and achieve operational efficiencies
* Project manage delivery and adoption of Lumafield’s technical solutions
* Identify, track, and quantify business impact, demonstrating ROI of Lumafield’s products and services
* Proactively manage renewal processes, mitigate churn risk, and maintain account health
* Uncover upsell, cross\-sell, and new use case opportunities to expand product usage
* Help build and scale internal processes, templates, and best practices

### **About you:**

* B.S. degree in Engineering
* 8\+ years of working experience, which should include technical experience in engineering or manufacturing, and client facing experience, such as in consulting, or program management
* Passionate about Lean, process improvement, quality, and bringing technology into manufacturing
* Excellent verbal and written communication that flexes to be effective across levels of an organization
* Commercial business exposure and interest, including understanding of budget cycles and planning
* Ability to independently create and deliver executive level presentations
* Extremely organized and are ready to dive head first into a rapidly scaling startup environment

### **Bonus:**

* MBA or equivalent business experience
* Program Management experience

Lumafield offers both competitive cash and equity compensation, as well as a health \& wellness stipend, 401k, parental leave, flexible PTO, commuter benefits, company wide events and more!

Lumafield is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, because the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. Do you feel like your skills don’t meet every single requirement listed? We encourage you to apply anyway – If you’re excited about our technology, the opportunity, and are eager to learn more we’d love to hear from you!

In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information or veteran status.

Reach out if you want to be a part of what we are building.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Sacramento Duals \+ Medi\-Cal Intensive Interventions** **Position Summary**
The Care Navigator will be embedded within the Kaiser Medical Center Emergency Department to support Kaiser Permanente Medi\-Cal members and dually eligible Medicare/Medi\-Cal members. The role is designed to provide high touch navigation, engagement, and linkage support for members with complex medical, behavioral health, social, and utilization needs.  

The Care Navigator will work closely with ED leadership, care coordination teams, social work, Transitional Care Services (TCS), Complex Case Management (CCM), Medicare teams, and community partners to help members navigate Kaiser Permanente services, CalAIM programs, and community\-based resources.  

The role focuses on real time member engagement in the ED setting, with the goal of improving care coordination, reducing avoidable ED utilization, and connecting members to the appropriate ongoing supports after discharge. **Core Responsibilities** **Member Identification and Engagement*** Review real time ED census lists and identify eligible members for outreach
* Conduct in person member engagement within the Emergency Department
* Prioritize outreach based on utilization patterns, clinical complexity, and operational workflow needs
* Participate in ED huddles, operational meetings, and staff workflows as an integrated member of the KP ED team

  

**Care Navigation and Coordination*** Support enrollment into Enhanced Care Management (ECM), including coordination with authorization teams when needed
* Provide navigation support for members already enrolled in ECM or other care coordination programs (Community Supports, Community Health Workers, etc.)
* Connect members to appropriate Kaiser Permanente services including:
* + Transitional Care Services (TCS)
	+ Complex Case Management (CCM)
	+ Social Work
	+ Medical Financial Assistance (MFA)
* Conduct basic assessments to identify and/or support social and community resource needs
* Connect members to community\-based organizations and external support programs when appropriate

  

**Benefits Support and Coordination*** Connect dually eligible members to the appropriate Kaiser Permanente Medicare or Health Care Options (Medi\-Cal) resources for conversion, alignment, or benefits related support
* Coordinate warm handoffs to internal Medicare / Medi\-Cal support teams when appropriate
* Assist non\-KP Medi\-Cal members with connection back to their assigned Managed Care Plan for available services and supports

**Member Follow\-Up and Operational Integration*** Conduct post visit telephonic follow up with members after ED discharge
* Participate in ongoing workflow refinement and pilot operational development
* Collaborate with ED leadership and KP operational teams to improve member identification and engagement processes
* Document outreach and interventions according to pilot workflows and operational guidance

* Experience working with Medi\-Cal, Medicare, Dual Eligible populations, or CalAIM programs
* Familiarity with hospital or Emergency Department operations
* Strong communication and patient engagement skills

jobs.title: Population Health & Sustainability Lead
jobs.description:
The UCSF Center for Advancing Dyadic Care in Pediatrics (CADP) is looking for an experienced professional and leader with a background in population health, managed care quality, and Medicaid financing who has a passion for public health, particularly when it comes to the intersection of mental health, social justice, and pediatric health care.


This position will serve as the Lead for the Population Health, Quality \& Sustainability Strategy Workstream for the UCSF Center for Advancing Dyadic Care in Pediatrics (CADP). The workstream lead will focus on how the CADP maximizes impact, scale, and long term sustainability. The role will be responsible for supporting partnerships with key stakeholders and partners, including California Managed Care Plans and government organizations, such as the California Department of Health Care Services, where they will draw upon their skills and expertise in health center operations , population health strategy, and Medicaid policy and finance to advance the objectives of the workstream. This key workstream joins five other leads of distinct workstreams and a dynamic, mission\-driven staff to collaboratively advance the vision of the UCSF CADP, which is to make family\-centered, dyadic behavioral health promotion and prevention a routine and sustainable standard of pediatric health care in early childhood. This role will focus primarily on scale, spread, and sustainability of dyadic services in California, integrating expertise in operations, policy, and payment to inform the CADP strategy of promoting utilization and implementation of new Dyadic Services Medi\-Cal Benefit (created as part of the Governor’s Children and Youth Behavioral Health Initiative). This position is critical to supporting population health, community, provider, and government stakeholders in implementing dyadic care services.


Working closely with UCSF CADP executive leadership to guide strategic goals and objectives, the Workstream Lead will function autonomously and as part of a team to develop, manage, and track deliverables from the Population Health, Quality, and Sustainability Strategy workstream. They will rely on best practices for innovating practice change and improvements, and promoting improved access to care. They will develop, oversee, and supervise the work of the Population Health, Quality and Sustainability Workstream, including a quality and sustainability specialist and a project manager in implementation of the workstream goals. This position is responsible for:


* Population health strategy
* Systems transformation
* Financial sustainability strategy
* Managed care strategy
* Quality improvement framework development
* Dissemination strategy
* Scaling and spread strategy
* Policy analysis, translation, and advocacy
* Serve as a consultant in improvement efforts

The Population Health \& Sustainability Lead represents an exciting opportunity to work closely with cross\-sector community, public health, government, and healthcare finances partnerships to promote and expand access to family\-centered, preventative behavioral health care for infants and young children. The ideal candidate will have experience working in Medicaid managed care settings and interfacing with fast\-paced hospital or public health settings, familiarity with common health and process outcome metrics, and is comfortable working with multiple stakeholders from a variety of backgrounds (clinical, public health, community\-based organizations, and patient stakeholders). The ideal candidate will be able to function both independently and as part of a team. It is preferred that the candidate have experience with managed care plans, pediatric health care, early childhood health and mental health, and public health financing .


  
Required Qualifications


* Bachelor's degree in related area and minimum five years of experience or equivalent experience / training.
* Minimum 3 years experience supervising staff in carrying out operational goals
* Minimum 3 years experience in population health or related Medicaid quality experience
* Thorough knowledge of organization or initiative processes, protocols and procedures.
* Solid knowledge of / common organizational\- or research\-specific computer application programs.
* Strong analytical / problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to communicate and influence others, both verbally and in writing.
* Advanced project management skills.
* Ability to multi\-task with demanding timeframes.
* Ability to use discretion and maintain all confidentiality.
* Solid knowledge of applicable policy analysis techniques.
  

Preferred Qualifications


* Healthcare leader with high degree of technical expertise in Medi\-Cal managed care operations, such as programs CalAIM, and the Children \& Youth Behavioral Health Initiative
* Education and training expertise and experience
* Business development knowledge
* Minimum 5 years experience in public health or Medicaid\-related work
* Advanced degree preferred.

  
**About UCSF**  

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate\-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10\-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.

UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .

jobs.title: People Operations Intern
jobs.description:
**About Etched**


Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co\-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best\-in\-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on **inference**. Backed by hundreds of millions from top\-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.

**Job Summary**


We are looking for a sharp, high\-agency intern to support People Operations and Legal. You will own real work across compliance, audits, employee operations, contracts, and company projects. You will investigate problems, organize messy information, work across teams, and drive projects through completion.


The role is based in our San Jose office.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Run People and Legal internal audits, including employment agreements, I\-9s, policies, and employee records
* Track compliance requirements and prepare filings, reports, and supporting records
* Review data across Rippling, spreadsheets, and source documents to find and fix gaps
* Support contracts, signatures, document storage, and other Legal operations
* Help manage onboarding, offboarding, employee changes, and recruiting handoffs
* Build clear guides and processes for employees, including travel and office resources
* Coordinate with People, Legal, Finance, Recruiting, and workplace teams
* Research employment and business requirements and turn findings into clear next steps
* Take on time\-sensitive projects as the company grows

**You may be a good fit if you have (Must\-have qualifications)**

* Current undergraduate or recent graduate interested in People Operations, Legal, or business operations
* Strong attention to detail
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Good judgment with sensitive information
* Able to work through incomplete or conflicting information
* Comfortable using spreadsheets and learning new systems
* Organized, reliable, and quick to follow through
* Willing to ask questions, find answers, and take ownership

**Strong candidates may also have experience with (Nice\-to\-have qualifications)**

* Previous internship, campus leadership, or volunteer experience involving administrative or operational support
* Familiarity with HR, recruiting, or document management systems
* Experience reviewing records, reconciling data, or flagging discrepancies
* Experience documenting processes or suggesting ways to make routine tasks more efficient

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every qualification.**

**Program details**

* 12\-week paid internship
* Generous housing support for those relocating
* Daily lunch and dinner in our office
* Based at our office in San Jose, CA
* Direct mentorship from industry leaders and world\-class engineers
* Opportunity to work on one of the most important problems of our time


For any questions, contact internships@etched.com.

**How we’re different**


Etched believes in the Bitter Lesson. We are the first inference\-focused frontier AI system, betting early on transformer and transformer\-like architectures and on increasing model sizes. Our addressable market is the entirety of inference, unlike many of our competitors.


We are a fully in\-person team in San Jose and Taipei, and greatly value engineering skills. We do not have boundaries between engineering and research, and we expect all of our technical staff to contribute to both and work across disciplines as needed.

jobs.title: People Operations
jobs.description:
**About Town**
--------------


We're an applied AI company building a powerful assistant that makes it easy for anyone to create and use software in their everyday work. Town builds a persistent model of you — your voice, judgment, relationships, priorities — and does real work on your behalf across every tool you use: email, calendar, docs, Slack, CRM. It doesn't wait to be prompted. It observes, learns, and acts.


We most recently raised a $55M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Forerunner Ventures and continued support from First Round Capital, Alt Capital, and Conviction — plus angels including Adam D'Angelo, Soleio Cuervo, and Immad Akhund. Our founders, Jean\-Denis and Tony, previously led EPD at Plaid and applied AI product at Google.

**About the role**
------------------


This is a build role. You'll own People Operations at Town end to end — onboarding, payroll, benefits, equity operations, immigration, compliance, HRIS — and design the version of it that still holds at 100 people. Most of what you'll own doesn't exist yet, and you'll build it with the Head of Talent and directly alongside Finance, outside counsel, and both founders. The cornerstone of this role is the latitude to build and decide how this function works.


The best part is that you'll do it at an applied AI company, using our own product on your own workflows. People Ops is full of work that shouldn't be manual, and here you'll have agents, engineers, and a mandate to automate as much of it as you can to keep the human work human.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own onboarding end to end, from signed offer letter through 90 day ramp
* Run Rippling as the system of record: payroll, benefits enrollment, employment data hygiene, and the audits that keep it accurate.
* Own HR compliance: employment policy, state registrations, leave administration, 401(k) and Form 5500, and the reporting obligations that come with growing headcount.
* Run immigration end to end with outside counsel — H\-1B transfers, E\-3s, green card timelines — and keep employees ahead of their own deadlines.
* Be the first stop for employee questions on benefits, pay, leave, and policy, and handle sensitive issues with discretion and sound judgment.
* Automate the repetitive parts. Town is building tools for people like you, and you'll get to use the most cutting edge, beta\-testing versions of these tools \- you should be using them on your own workflows.

**You might thrive here if you**
--------------------------------

* Have experience in People Ops or HR at a high\-growth startup, ideally with some time as the person building the function (vs just inheriting it)
* Have been responsible for an HRIS and have opinions about how it should be configured.

* Are in SF and want to be in the office five days a week

jobs.title: Operations Lead, Investor Relations
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



Anthropic's Investor Relations team manages our relationships with shareholders, prospective investors, and the broader financial community, and helps educate investors on Anthropic's mission, strategy, and financial performance. As the Operations Lead for the team, you'll own the administrative and operational backbone that keeps IR running smoothly, from coordinating investor meetings and preparing the team for them to managing the vendors and logistics behind high\-profile events and visits.



You'll work directly with the Head of Investor Relations and the IR team, and cross\-functionally with Finance leadership, Finance \& Strategy, Capital Markets, Accounting, Corporate Legal, Communications, and Workplace, to make sure every investor touchpoint reflects well on Anthropic. Because the function is still being built, you will often be creating the process rather than following one. This role suits someone who is highly proactive, thrives on structure, anticipates needs before they arise, and enjoys being the person who makes complex logistics look effortless.


**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Schedule and coordinate investor calls, meetings, and briefings, managing calendars across multiple stakeholders and time zones, and helping the team prioritize when investor demand exceeds our capacity
* Partner with internal teams and on\-site staff to plan and execute investor events, visits, and other in\-person engagements
* Prepare the team and executives for investor conversations and capturing follow\-ups afterward
* Own vendor relationships for IR\-related services, from sourcing through ongoing management of scope, budget, and performance
* Help the team set agendas and priorities, tracking deliverables and following up to ensure commitments are met on time
* Maintain and organize IR records, the investor contact database and interaction history, and shared materials so information stays easy to find and current, and help select and run the tools the team uses to track shareholder engagement
* Serve as a primary point of contact for internal stakeholders and external partners on logistical and administrative questions
* Build and document the recurring processes a growing IR function needs, from meeting request intake through post\-meeting follow\-up, and keep improving how the team operates day to day
* Partner with Corporate Legal and Communications on the handling and review of investor\-facing materials, so information moves through the right checks
* Support ad hoc projects as investor relations priorities evolve

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------


* Experience coordinating complex calendars, meetings, or events across multiple stakeholders
* Experience managing vendor relationships, including scope, budget, and performance tracking
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities and deadlines
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated judgment handling sensitive, confidential, and market\-sensitive information with discretion
* Comfort operating autonomously in a newly formed team, including building processes and systems that do not exist yet

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience supporting an investor relations, capital markets, or finance leadership function, ideally in a company that was growing quickly
* Familiarity with the needs of external\-facing, high\-stakes engagements
* Experience operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth company environment
* A proactive, detail\-oriented approach to identifying and solving problems before they become issues
* Familiarity with investor relations or CRM tools for tracking shareholder engagement, and comfort using AI tools to work faster
* Curiosity about financial markets, technology, and AI, and interest in how a research\-driven company explains itself to investors

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.



For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.


Annual Salary:


$200,000 \- $265,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------


**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience


**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience


**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position


**Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.


**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

jobs.title: Learning and Development Manager
jobs.description:
Nestled in San Francisco's Excelsior neighborhood on a nine\-acre campus, the San Francisco Campus for Jewish Living (SFCJL) is the leading senior services organization in Northern California. Our continuum of care includes: the Frank Residences assisted living and memory care; the Jewish Home and Rehabilitation Center, offering long\-term skilled nursing, short\-term rehabilitation, an acute geriatric psychiatric unit for adults over the age of 65; and our Foundation.



Founded in 1871 and formerly known as the Jewish Home, our legacy grounds us as our vision propels us forward. Today, we've evolved to support more than 2,500 older adults each year through innovative, comprehensive programs rooted in the Jewish values of compassion, community, and excellence. We are equally proud of our inclusive culture, where 950 team members of diverse faiths and backgrounds work together in shared purpose.


**WHY WORK WITH US**


* Mission\-driven nonprofit organization
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits
* Meaningful work that positively impacts the lives of older adults every day
* Inclusive community, welcoming to all (you do not need to be Jewish to live or work here)
* Supportive, team\-oriented environment
* Opportunities for professional growth and development
* Collaborative leadership focused on enhancing the employee experience
**POSITION SUMMARY**  

The Learning and Development Manager is a newly created position within the Human Resources Department responsible for building and leading an organization\-wide learning and development function.



This role develops, implements, facilitates, and evaluates learning strategies and programs that strengthen employee capability, leadership effectiveness, regulatory readiness, performance, engagement, and succession planning. The Manager partners closely with executive and department leaders to assess organizational and role\-specific learning needs and translate those needs into practical, measurable development solutions. This position also supports a culture of continuous learning by coordinating required and role\-specific education, strengthening manager and supervisor capability, and ensuring learning programs align with organizational priorities, applicable regulatory requirements, resident\-centered service standards, and the needs of a diverse workforce.



The Learning and Development Manager owns the learning lifecycle, from needs assessment and instructional design through delivery, measurement, continuous improvement, vendor management, and learning technology administration, and uses data to demonstrate program effectiveness and business impact.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Develop and execute a comprehensive, organization\-wide learning and development strategy aligned with strategic priorities, workforce needs, organizational values, and employee development goals.
* Conduct organization\-wide and department\-level training needs assessments using performance data, compliance requirements, employee feedback, leadership input, and operational trends.
* Design, develop, facilitate, and continuously improve instructor\-led, virtual, blended, and e\-learning programs using adult learning and instructional design principles.

* Partner with appropriate subject\-matter experts to coordinate and track required training and education applicable to the organization, workforce, and healthcare environment.
* Collaborate with department heads to create consistent onboarding and new\-hire learning frameworks that support successful integration, role readiness, organizational culture, and retention.
* Develop meaningful learning metrics and dashboards; evaluate participation, knowledge transfer, behavior change, compliance, employee experience, and organizational impact, and recommend improvements based on results.
* Manage the L\&D budget, external vendors, consultants, training contracts, and learning resources to maximize quality, value, and organizational impact.
* Stay current on learning technologies, instructional design practices, workforce\-development trends, and relevant senior living/healthcare training requirements and incorporate appropriate best practices.
* Develop and maintain training standards, templates, facilitator guides, learning materials, and documentation to promote consistency and quality.
* Facilitate learning sessions for employees and leaders and coach internal subject\-matter experts and facilitators on effective training delivery.
* Promote an inclusive learning environment and incorporate accessibility, cultural responsiveness, and equitable development opportunities into learning programs.
* Support change\-management initiatives by developing communication, education, and adoption strategies for organizational changes, new systems, policies, and processes.
* Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned.

all detailing staff. jobs.title: Business Analyst, MDO
jobs.description:
**Our values start with our people, join a team that values you!**


Bring your talents to Ross, our leading off\-price retail chain with over 2,200 stores, and a strong track record of success and growth. Our focus has always been bringing our customers a constant stream of high\-quality brands and on\-trend merchandise at extraordinary savings. All while providing a fun and exciting treasure hunt experience.


As part of our team, you will experience:

* **Success**. Our winning team pursues excellence while learning and evolving
* **Career growth**. We develop industry leading talent because Ross grows when our people grow
* **Teamwork**. We work together to solve the hard problems and find the right solution
* **Our commitment to Diversity, Equality \& Inclusion, and our community.** We celebrate the backgrounds, identities, and ideas of those who work and shop with us because our differences make us stronger. We strive to be a positive force in our community.

  

Our Corporate headquarters are in Dublin, CA, we have 3 buying offices in key markets in New York City, Los Angeles, and Boston, and 8 distribution centers nationwide. With 2023 revenues of $20\.4 billion, we are a Fortune 500 company who is committed to providing an inclusive work environment with continuous learning opportunities and development for our teams.

### **About this opportunity...**

**This role will support the MDO vision to be the central point of contact for all master data needs within a certain data domain (i.e., Supplier, Location Hierarchy, Merchant and Buyer Hierarchies). Partnering with both their direct supervisor (Lead) and department Manager, the Business Analyst will ensure that all requests are prioritized, addressed and resolved in a timely manner. The role is responsible for:*** Managing enterprise data in the MDM system and tools (data management includes review, entry, audit) while working directly with business areas and partner departments.
* Working on assignments (data review and entry in workflows), projects and problems of limited to medium scope in partnership with project or department leadership.
* Partnering with their Supervisor, the role will ensure that all requests are prioritized, addressed and resolved in a timely manner.
* Continually build on content knowledge for data management and processes.
* Provide governance documentation or process documentation.
* Analysis of data; or to provide business insights via metrics or training.
### **What you will do and what you will learn...**

**SME and Point of Contact for Business*** As point of contact for multiple business departments across the organization, the Business Analyst will play an important role to support multiple business units, address regular requests, and troubleshoot issues.
* Analyze data to troubleshoot or provide data insights and business visibility.
* Become the subject matter expert for Supplier, Org, and Location Master’s business use.
**Documentation*** Ensure that existing governance and process documents are up to date based on changes in requirements or business needs.
* Create and maintain a library of all training materials and guides.
**Request Management*** Manage workflow and requests in a Master Data Management Tool. Execute on all (change) requests from business effectively to ensure that they are implemented according to set data governance standards and processes.
 **Process Improvement/Projects*** Identify and provide recommendations on ways to better service the business.
 **Compliance and Adoption*** Verify all Master Data Management processes around data governance are followed.
* Play an integral role in escalating requests that do not comply with the governance set by MDO.
* Be Subject Matter Expert (SME) for all Ross specific data management and processes.
* Build deep content knowledge around how the business end\-users use this foundational data to run the business.
### **What you need to be successful...**

* Bachelor’s Degree with a concentration in Business, Economics, Finance, HR, or Computer Science, or an equivalent diploma
* 3\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, (preferably in Retail or in an IT field), with strong process, data, and systems understanding
* Prior Data Governance and Administration experience or exposure preferred
* Thorough knowledge of business process documentation that includes prior experience with documenting Merchandising, IT or Finance workflows, processes and requirements
* Ability to work with both business (non\-technical) and IT (technical) with ability to communicate/translate requirements easily and effectively between all parties
* Strong understanding of productivity suite software (i.e., Microsoft Office)
* Ability to understand and apply instructions or suggest alternate proven methods to move projects or requests forward
* Strong analytical skills
* Ability to follow established practices, policies and procedures
* Strong communication skills
* Ability to build working relationships and bring about cooperation from leadership and working teams
* Ability to adjust with changing work environments, priorities and goals
**Perks and Benefits of joining our team...**


Our Associates are at the heart of everything we do and we're proud to offer a range of benefits that reflect how much we value their contributions. Here's a peek into what you can expect as an eligible Ross Associate:

* A broad range of affordable health insurance options \& personal medical plan concierge  

401(k) with employer match and Life insurance
* Ample PTO including accrued vacation, paid holidays, diversity day, summer Fridays and the ability to purchase additional vacation.
* Employee stock purchase plan\*
* Access to health and wellness benefits such as BetterHelp and Headspace
* Charitable donations matched by Ross Stores Foundation
* And more....
* benefits vary by level and position and are subject to change

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**BRIEF DESCRIPTION:**
The Program Coordinator is actively involved in the managed repair programs BluSky has committed to provide excellent customer service. This includes daily involvement of commercial and residential losses assigned to BluSky. This is a highly interactive position that is essential to the success of the company's growth within the managed repair program industry. The Program Coordinator will work closely with the office Vice Presidents, Project Estimators, Project Managers, and Regional Program Directors to ensure key performance measures are being met on a consistent basis.
**PRINCIPAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**PROGRAM RELATED TASKS:**
* Will be familiar with all managed repair program requirements related to:


o Initial Contact time
o Time to inspect the loss.
o Estimate upload times.
o Update notes
o Documents such as work authorizations and certificates of satisfaction.
o Labeled Photos
* Will be familiar with managed repair program online systems:


o Xactanalysis, Claims Connect, Contractor Dashboard, and AlacNet.
o Additional systems as required by the programs.
* Will assist on initial contact and scheduling of inspections for PDs/PEs, as needed.


* Will assist Program Compliance Managers in the retrieval of office specific information.


o Recertifications.
o License and Insurance Compliance.
o Weekly POM's reports.
o Daily Job Tracker Review.
o Work with VPs \& Program Coordinators on any changes/zip code, trades, deactivations/reactivations, etc.
o Review assignments/compliance to program guidelines, assist PM's when needed, troubleshoot and work with program contacts to help resolve.
o Password maintenance for shared/branch accounts like Contractor Connection Dashboard.
* *Many of these tasks are unique to each branch so they have to be completed for all active branches on residential/commercial work*


**WORK IN PRODUCTION RELATED TASKS:**
* Demonstrate a knowledge of the status of every Program project.


* Work with on\-site Project Managers/Superintendents to deliver the highest possible quality and customer satisfaction.
* Sending and following up with subcontractor bids on projects for PMs/PDs/PEs as needed


* Ensure Supplements and applicable change orders are completed by PDs/PEs and get to Project Managers/client in reasonable time frame.
* Verify and assist with all document uploads.


* Assist with expediting project change orders to clients.
* Assist with ensuring Supplements are completed by estimators/PDs/PEs and gets to Project Managers/client.


* Assist Project Managers/PDs/PEs in completion of projects and other needs necessary to maximize profit.


**CUSTOMER SERVICE\-RELATED TASKS:**
* Contact the customer regularly through the project to check on how they feel the project is going.


* Be another point of contact in case the PM/PD/PE is not immediately available.


* Advise the customer about surveys and the BluSky goal to be rated a 10 on every question.


* Ask customers to call if the level of service is not meeting expectation so that BluSky can get concerns addressed as soon as possible.


**COMPETENCIES, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**
* Must demonstrate a high level of accuracy and consistent work performance.


* Works well in a fast\-paced environment with multiple tasks, priorities, and deadlines.


* Positive teamwork attitude


* Strong problem solving, analytical and multi\-tasking skills.


* High level of interpersonal skills with the ability to engage in teams and different personality types.


* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**QUALIFICATIONS \& REQUIREMENTS:**
* Managed repair program experience


* Must be proficient with Microsoft Office suite with strong Microsoft Excel skills.


**EDUCATION:**
Associate degree in Business Administration or a construction related field preferred, but not required.
**WORK ENVIRONMENT \& PHYSICAL JOB DEMANDS:**
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet.
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, talk, and hear. The employee is required to regularly move and walk around the office.
**TRAVEL:**
Occasional travel. This position is primarily local to Corporate Office. Some out\-of\-area and overnight travel may be expected for training or meetings.

jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote, U.S.\-based, Eastern Time Zone Hours  

**Position Type:** Full\-time  

**Reports to:** OPR President \& CEO, with day\-to\-day reporting to the client’s various US Patient Advocacy therapeutic area leads

  

  

**About OPR**


Olshan Patient Relations (OPR) is a boutique patient engagement consulting firm that helps pharmaceutical companies integrate patient and caregiver perspectives throughout drug development and commercialization. We serve as a strategic partner to clients, delivering work that is decision\-enabling, scientifically responsible, and respectful of patients, caregivers, and advocates.

  

  

**Position overview**


OPR is seeking an Associate of Client Services to manage a program for a major pharmaceutical client that is focused on embedding the patient perspective in US drug development initiatives during and after product launch. This associate will manage the end\-to\-end process for the client’s US Patient Insight Panels (PIPs), working in close partnership with members of the US Patient Advocacy team and their internal cross\-functional colleagues.


PIPs are organized by disease areas and are comprised of patients, caregivers, and patient advocates who have year\-long consulting agreements with the client to provide feedback on the company’s patient\-facing initiatives such as marketing programs, disease awareness campaigns, patient education, patient support services, and patient experience research. The PIPs are part of the US Patient Advocacy team’s strategy to collaborate with relevant patient communities to understand unmet needs that inform business strategy, mobilize patients to seek the best care and reduce access barriers. Consultations with PIP advisors are entirely virtual.


The client has separate PIPs for various disease areas, including but not limited to:


* Oncology
* Cardiovascular disease
* Immune disorders
* Rare diseases

This individual will be an employee of OPR and will report administratively to OPR, while working day to day under the direction of the client’s US Patient Advocacy team.

  

  

**Key responsibilities**


The client’s US Patient Advocacy department is run internally by Patient Advocacy Leads, each of whom sets strategy and leads collaboration with patient communities from different disease areas. Every Patient Advocacy Lead manages a PIP in their respective disease area. It will be the responsibility of OPR’s Associate of Client Services to provide support to each Patient Advocacy Lead to manage their respective PIPs. This will include:


* Conducting regular update calls with Patient Advocacy Leads to assess their needs
* Managing the process of setting up PIPs in each disease area at the beginning of every year and reconciling PIPs at the end of every year
* Managing timelines, deliverables, meeting preparation, follow\-up, and documentation for PIP projects
* Serving as the primary liaison between internal project teams and PIP advisors, ensuring effective and appropriate engagement throughout project lifecycles
* Maintaining accurate project records, documentation, tracking tools, and databases
* Monitoring advisor participation and project hours to support payment processes
* Identifying opportunities to improve PIP processes, templates, and project workflows, and maintaining and updating PIP standard operating procedures to align with evolving company practices
* Serving as a subject matter expert on the PIP consulting model, providing guidance and answering questions from advisors and internal cross\-functional colleagues
* Anticipating client needs and proactively identifying issues, risks, and next steps
* Helping to maintain strong client relationships through clear, responsive, and thoughtful communication
* Following all applicable laws and client policies, and reporting any instances of non\-compliance to the client’s Legal and Compliance departments
* Promoting the responsible use of AI\-enabled tools to strengthen PIP program quality, consistency, and efficiency

Training will be provided on OPR’s PIP processes, client systems, and relevant tools.

  

  

**Qualifications**


***Required***


* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, public health, communications, healthcare administration, social sciences, or a related field
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare consulting, patient advocacy, patient engagement, medical affairs, clinical development, or a related healthcare field
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage timelines, details, and multiple workstreams
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience working with clients, internal stakeholders, or external partners
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment
* Strong judgment, professionalism, and attention to detail
* Proficient with Microsoft Office tools, including Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and SharePoint
* Interest in patient\-centered healthcare and the importance of integrating patient and caregiver perspectives throughout drug development and commercialization

***Preferred***


* Experience working with or within pharmaceutical patient advocacy functions
* Experience engaging with patient advocacy organizations or patient communities
* Experience supporting advisory boards, insight panels, interviews, workshops, or qualitative research
* Ability to translate scientific or clinical topics into clear, patient\-friendly language
* Consulting, agency, or client\-service experience
* Experience working with AI enabled tools

**Compensation**


The salary for this position is expected to range between $85,000 and $115,000 per year. The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience. Full\-time OPR employees receive a benefits package that includes health insurance, a Simple IRA with company contribution and match, and paid time off for vacation, sick days and holidays.
