**Job Description**

**A bit about this role:**


Devoted Medical is building clinical programs to manage and coordinate care in a manner consistent with Devoted's values of treating every member like family. Medication plays a crucial role in helping people manage chronic conditions, but in many cases effective medication management is limited by barriers to access, uncoordinated prescribing, or a failure to use the most effective evidence\-based medication therapies. For example, despite a mountain of evidence, less than 1 in 10 people with congestive heart failure (CHF) are prescribed evidence\-based medications proven to save lives and prevent hospitalizations.


Devoted's clinical pharmacy team aims to support improved therapeutics for Devoted members. It supports this work in three ways:

* *Conducting medication reviews (via direct member engagement and pharmacist consult support for other clinicians)*
* *Virtual pharmacist\-led or clinician\-led care via telemedicine to close therapy gaps*
* *Coordinating care for changes in therapy by counseling members and engaging prescribers and pharmacies*

**This work is done in service of a number of goals. The clinical pharmacy team drives Devoted's quality and Medicare Stars performance across multiple programs such as:**

* **SUPD (Statin Use in Persons with Diabetes)**
* **SPC (Statin Use in Persons with Heart Disease)**
* **MTM (Medication Therapy Management)**
* **TCC (Total Cost of Care)**
* **Polypharmacy**


During appointments with our pharmacists and clinicians, medication opportunities are identified.That's where Pharmacy Care Coordinators (PCCs) step in. PCCs ensure recommendations reach the outside provider, follow up with pharmacies on claims issues, pick\-up confirmations, or discontinuations, and keep the member informed of any changes along the way.


As a PCC, you will partner with our Clinical Pharmacy and Operations teams on outreach, coordination, and follow\-up to provide best in class care to our members, as part of a mission\-driven, team\-oriented, joyful culture.

* Supports clinical outreach campaigns by making outbound calls and utilizing portal chat to members to schedule appointments with the pharmacist team to address clinical gaps or medication concerns

* Independently oversees assigned cases and outreaches with timely follow\-up, clear next steps, and thorough documentation

* Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls to members, providers, and pharmacies
* Comfortable managing daily responsibilities and tasks independently
* Ability to shift between tasks, projects, and priorities frequently

**Desired skills and experience:**

* Comfortable learning new software and adapting as tools and workflows evolve
* Adaptable and flexible, with a willingness to take on new or shifting tasks positively
* A true team player who brings new ideas to the table, works through solutions with others, and lifts up their teammates
* Comfortable speaking with physicians, pharmacies, and patients, with a genuine passion for our members

* A transparent communicator about your work, what's going well, and what's not, with a thoughtful eye for improving processes

Working with client stakeholders and APV's instructional design, eLearning, multimedia, graphics, technical writing, quality assurance, and Section 508 personnel, the manager will coordinate multiple concurrent course workstreams and ensure that each product is accurate, engaging, evidence\-based, accessible, maintainable, and aligned with applicable regulatory training systems and National Curriculum Standard requirements.

  

**DUTIES**

  


* Lead authorized eLearning and online\-module projects from initiation through final acceptance, establishing scope, responsibilities, milestones, dependencies, review gates, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.
* Translate client direction, course evaluation findings, approved Course Development Plans, Course Design Documents, and\-training requirements into executable eLearning production plans and schedules.
* Manage concurrent module\-development workstreams and coordinate instructional designers, eLearning developers, graphic artists, video and multimedia specialists, technical writers, subject matter experts, LMS personnel, and accessibility and quality reviewers.
* Ensure online modules apply evidence\-based instructional design and adult\-learning practices and align objectives, content, interactive activities, games, simulations, practice, and assessments with applicable standards.
* Control scope, schedule, labor, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and changes; identify potential delays or resource constraints early and provide actionable status and recovery recommendations to APV leadership.
* Support project\-level planning and reporting by maintaining accurate eLearning milestones, accomplishments, upcoming work, risks, issues, and client\-directed changes for inclusion in the Program Plan, Monthly Status Reports, and final reporting.
* Facilitate requirements, design, storyboard, prototype, courseware, testing, and acceptance reviews; document decisions and action items, route materials to the appropriate reviewers, and verify incorporation of approved feedback.
* Manage development of SCORM\-compliant modules compatible with the LMS and suitable for use on the client network, coordinating technical requirements and testing with the COR, designated client Project Manager, applicable IT personnel, and LMS administrators.
* Ensure PDF, Word, or PowerPoint source content is provided before SCORM packaging, as required by the SOW, and that HTML\-created source files are not submitted as the required source\-file deliverable.

* Coordinate independent Section 508 testing and remediation so all modules and supporting electronic materials meet applicable Section 508 and WCAG Level A and AA requirements and include the required compliance checklist at final submission.
* Establish and enforce configuration management, file naming, version control, change tracking, approval, release, and archive practices across storyboards, media, source files, test evidence, and published packages
* Verify that final deliveries include reusable and editable Government\-owned source files, SCORM packages, supporting documentation, and properly licensed or authorized assets free of restrictions that would limit Government and partner use.
* Coordinate technical and scientific validation with subject matter experts and secure Government approval before finalization or deployment; do not authorize release based solely on internal review.
* Maintain production quality through regular team reviews, workload balancing, schedule forecasting, risk escalation, corrective action, and lessons learned across the eLearning portfolio.
* Prepare for client\-directed changes in course sequencing, priorities, or delivery format and support reasonable surge or emergency conversion requests within the SOW's five\-business\-day response expectations.
* Protect client information and Government\-furnished materials by using only approved systems, tools, and transfer methods and by enforcing contract security, privacy, records\-management, AI\-use, and information\-handling requirements.

jobs.description:
STR Operations Manager / Founder’s Right Hand

**Future Director of Operations / GM Opportunity**

**$22–$27/hr \| \~20 Hours/Week to Start \| 90\-Day Paid Trial**

This Is Not a Typical Part\-Time Operations Job

We are looking for an experienced **short\-term rental operator with the ambition and capability to eventually help run multiple growing businesses.**

This position starts part\-time because several of our newest growth initiatives are still ramping.

**The position is not intended to stay small.**

We operate businesses in short\-term rental revenue management, remote STR management, and home services. We have established operations, active leads, new services launching, and significant growth opportunities.

The founder has become too involved in day\-to\-day execution.

We need someone who can eventually become the founder’s **\#2**.

The right person won't simply manage what exists. You'll help us **build and scale what comes next.**

Professional STR Experience Is Required

You should already understand professional STR operations, including:

* Airbnb/Vrbo
* Owner and guest communication
* Property onboarding
* Listing setup/optimization
* Cleaners and maintenance
* PMS platforms such as Guesty, Hospitable, Hostaway, etc.
* PriceLabs or similar dynamic pricing software
* STR performance and revenue\-management fundamentals

Experience professionally operating **20\+ STR properties is strongly preferred**.

We need someone who already understands this industry—not someone we need to teach STR operations from scratch.

What You'll Do

You'll initially work directly with the founder to:

* Coordinate STR client onboarding and operations
* Manage owner communication and routine client issues
* Keep leads, contracts, and onboarding moving
* Coordinate with revenue managers and other team members
* Help manage GoHighLevel CRM and automations
* Improve listings and operational processes
* Build SOPs and scalable systems
* Track KPIs and identify problems
* Follow up with employees and contractors
* Help oversee operations within our home\-services company
* Hold team members accountable
* Solve routine operational problems without involving the founder

Most importantly, you'll help us **scale**.

When we add another 20, 50, or 100 properties, we want you thinking:

**What needs to change? Who do we need? What should we automate? What will break next? How do we grow without creating chaos?**

We don't want to push someone to think this way.

We're looking for someone who naturally does.

Who We're Looking For

You might currently be an STR Operations Manager, Portfolio Manager, Senior Property Manager, or similar professional who knows you're capable of more.

You:

* Take ownership without being chased
* Solve problems before they become emergencies
* Build systems instead of repeatedly fixing the same problem
* Can lead and hold people accountable
* Understand numbers and KPIs
* Communicate professionally with owners
* Make good decisions independently
* Learn technology quickly
* Use automation and AI intelligently
* Think ahead as a company grows
* Want your responsibility and career to grow with the business

We want someone who increasingly tells the founder:

**“I've already handled it.”**

The Upside

Our philosophy is simple:

**The more value you create and the more these businesses grow, the more opportunity there should be for you to grow with them.**

A successful person can progress toward:

**Operations Manager → Director of Operations → General Manager / Founder’s \#2**

That can mean increased hours, compensation, authority, team leadership, and performance\-based compensation opportunities as the role develops.

Advancement isn't automatic. It will be earned through results.

But we are specifically recruiting someone who has the **capability to grow far beyond the starting position.**

Compensation

**$22–$27/hour depending on experience**

Approximately **20 hours/week initially**

**90\-day paid trial**

We will evaluate progress around Days 30, 60, and 90 based on ownership, reliability, problem\-solving, leadership, systems improvement, and how much operational responsibility you've successfully taken from the founder.

Strong performance can lead to increased hours, compensation, responsibility, and a long\-term leadership position.

**We're looking for someone who may eventually become an exceptional operator and business leader.**

Pay: $22\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* How many STR properties have you professionally helped operate, and what were you personally responsible for?
* Why are you interested in a position that starts part\-time but could develop into running a much larger operation?
* Which PMS, pricing, CRM, and STR platforms have you used?

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Claim Warriors (www.claimwarriors.com) is a fast\-growing insurance claims advocacy company that helps property owners navigate denied, underpaid, and complex insurance claims. We coordinate with claim professionals, attorneys, contractors, and other industry partners to help clients pursue fair outcomes and move their claims forward.

We are looking for an organized and dependable Operations Manager to help coordinate our claims and keep daily workflows moving efficiently.

This person will work closely with our Claims Manager, Sales Manager, Claim Consultants, attorneys, contractors, and customer support team. The Operations Manager will also oversee three Virtual Project Managers who assist with claim management, attorney referrals, and our contractor network.

The ideal candidate is organized, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and good at following up with people to make sure tasks are completed.

***Main Responsibilities***

Claims Management

* Make sure each claim is properly set up with the required documents, including policies, carrier decisions, estimates, photographs, and payment information.
* Confirm that Claim Consultants are contacting customers and documenting important claim details.
* Monitor active claims to ensure they are regularly updated.
* Follow up on claims or tasks that have been delayed.
* Work with the Claims Manager to keep claims organized and progressing.

Attorney Referrals

* Help move qualified customers from Claim Warriors to our attorney partners.
* Make sure attorneys receive the documents and information they need.
* Track customers from the attorney referral stage through attorney onboarding.
* Coordinate estimates, reports, work orders, and invoices with attorneys and outside claim consultants.

Contractor Network

* Prepare qualified claims for submission to our contractor network.
* Make sure each submission includes the necessary policies, estimates, photographs, and claim documents.
* Follow up on underwriting decisions and requests for additional information.
* Record approved project amounts and track the progress of approved work.
* Help prepare and submit affiliate\-fee invoices.

Customer Support

* Help organize and oversee customer support requests.
* Make sure customer questions are assigned to the appropriate team member.
* Follow up on unanswered or overdue customer requests.
* Help resolve issues and improve the overall customer experience.

Team and Process Management

* Manage and support three Virtual Project Managers.
* Assign priorities and monitor task completion.
* Review closed claims to determine whether they should be reopened, referred to an attorney, or formally closed.
* Identify workflow delays and recommend practical improvements.
* Help create simple performance goals and reporting for team members.

Qualifications

* Experience in operations, project management, insurance claims, legal services, construction, restoration, or a related field is helpful.
* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* Comfortable working with customers, attorneys, contractors, and remote team members.
* Able to manage several projects and priorities at the same time.
* Experience with CRM or project\-management software is preferred.
* Willingness to learn our processes and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is proactive, organized, and dependable. You do not need to know everything on your first day. We will provide guidance on our workflows and expectations.

The most important qualities are a positive attitude, strong follow\-through, attention to detail, and a willingness to help the team keep claims and customer requests moving forward.

Work Location

This is a 100% remote position. Claim Warriors has headquarters in Los Angeles and Chicago, where occasional in\-person meetings may take place. Proper advance notice will be provided whenever attendance is requested.

Pay: From $120,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:

### **Company Overview**

  

  

Function Health is the AI operating system for health, designed to empower people to live 100 healthy years. We are redefining how individuals understand, measure, and improve their health by moving beyond the limitations of traditional care and enabling comprehensive, continuous insight into human biology. Function has been recognized as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2024, and is venture\-backed by Redpoint and other leading venture firms. Over half a million members have joined Function to take control of their health.  

  

Through comprehensive lab testing, MRI and CT imaging, longitudinal data, and guidance from AI and clinical teams, Function gives members a complete and continuous view of their health — and the clarity to act on it. Through acquisitions across imaging, mobile phlebotomy, and supplement tracking and optimization, Function is building an integrated health platform that spans the full path from testing to health clarity to daily action.  

  

Function recently announced a $298M Series B and is entering its next chapter of growth. As we scale, the quality and durability of our People systems, data, and insights will directly shape our ability to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent.  

  

We are growing our team and seeking out world\-class talent that deeply believes in our mission to positively impact global health, has a relentless bias toward action, and a growth mindset. Function fosters a collaborative and dynamic environment where every day we build the future.  

  

### **Role**

  

  

The **Revenue Accounting Project Manager** will help build and standardize how Function Health's revenue accounting function operates — the processes it runs on and the systems that support them — without performing the close itself. This role sits at the intersection of accounting, process design, and cross\-functional execution: you'll understand accounting treatment well enough to shape sound requirements and standards, and you'll project\-manage the work needed to get there, in service of a team that owns the close.  

  

You'll work across multiple revenue streams, each with its own systems, maturity level, and open questions. You'll support the team's initiative roadmap by surfacing where a process or control needs attention, then take ownership of sequencing, scoping, and driving that work to a documented, repeatable outcome. That often involves systems and data, but just as often it's about establishing how something should work as a matter of process, independent of any one tool. The ideal candidate has an accounting background and can speak the language fluently, but is energized by building the structure around accounting rather than executing the close itself. You're naturally curious, comfortable digging into ambiguity to find the root cause of a problem, and able to independently manage a project from open questions to a finished, standardized process.  

  

You will report to the **Senior Revenue Accounting Manager,** and operate with a high degree of autonomy on your workstreams while receiving direction on priorities and judgment calls. This is a strong fit for someone who wants ownership over how the function's processes and initiatives take shape — bringing forward what they're noticing, flagging what doesn't make sense, and driving cross\-functional projects to completion with minimal oversight once scoped.  

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

  

* **Support the Senior Manager in shaping the accounting initiative roadmap** — surfacing process gaps, risks, and opportunities, then owning the scoping and prioritization of your workstreams once direction is set.
* **Design and standardize accounting processes and controls across revenue streams** — independent of any single system — so operations run consistently and predictably as the business scales.
* **Own end\-to\-end project management for revenue accounting initiatives** — scoping requirements, sequencing workstreams, tracking open items across stakeholders, and driving projects to completion against a deadline.
* **Serve as the connective tissue between Accounting and Data/Engineering, Finance, and Product** — gathering requirements, resolving ambiguity between teams, and ensuring decisions made in one function are accurately reflected in another.
* Translate accounting treatment and technical judgment into system requirements and configuration logic for ERP/revenue recognition systems, partnering with implementation teams and internal engineering resources.
* **Investigate data quality and process breakdowns by working directly with underlying datasets** — tracing issues to root cause rather than reconciling around them, and partnering with Data/Engineering to fix them at the source.
* Build and maintain documentation, mapping logic, and handoff materials that convert undocumented or ad hoc knowledge into clear, auditable procedures the accounting team can run against.
* Prepare clear, organized documentation and data support for external audit and advisory partners on request, without owning the audit relationship directly.
  

  

### **Qualifications/Skills**

  

  

* 7\+ years of progressive experience spanning accounting and either project management, business/systems analysis, or accounting operations; ***Big 4 public accounting experience is strongly preferred.***
* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* Solid understanding of **US GAAP and ASC 606** revenue recognition, including application to subscription or service\-based revenue models — strong enough to shape sound requirements and standards, even without performing the close.
* Demonstrated project management skills — able to independently scope, sequence, and drive a cross\-functional initiative to completion.
* Experience designing or standardizing operational processes and controls, not just exe

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
#### **About Melita**



For more than 30 years, Melita Group has helped small and mid\-sized employers solve the complexity of HR, Employee Benefits, and Payroll. We combine deep expertise with a modern technology platform to deliver outsourced services that let our clients focus on growing their businesses while we handle the operational backbone of their workforce. We are a results\-driven, high\-integrity organization that holds itself accountable to its promises, and our clients stay with us for years, often decades, because we treat their success as our own. As we scale, we are investing heavily in technology, automation, and AI to raise the bar on what an HR outsourcing partner can deliver.


#### **The Opportunity**



Every new client relationship begins with implementation, and the quality of that experience sets the trajectory for retention, expansion, and reference\-ability for years to come. The Implementation Specialist is a hands\-on role that supports bringing complex HR, benefits, and payroll clients live on our platform. You will do the configuration, data migration, and testing yourself, not just manage it from a distance.



Reporting to the Head of Implementations, you will support onboardings end to end and be the connective tissue that ensures what was sold is what gets delivered. This role is ideal for someone who has implemented outsourced Payroll and HR services at a PEO, an HRO, or an HRIS technology vendor, and who wants to do the work, contribute to the outcome, and help shape how we implement as we scale.


#### **Reporting and Scope**


* **Reports to:** Head of Implementations (Molly Taylor)
* **Department and team:** Client Success, Implementation Team
* **Location:** Remote (U.S.)
* **Key partners:** Sales, Client Success, Service Delivery, the internal Technology team, Product, and Finance, along with HRIS and benefits carrier partners

### **Core Responsibilities:**


#### **Client Implementations (hands\-on)**


* Support and help execute new client onboardings across HR administration, payroll, benefits, and leave of absence services, from kickoff to a clean handoff to the ongoing service teams.
* Contribute directly to the outcomes that matter: time to live, client satisfaction at go\-live, and a smooth transition to Service Delivery.
* Help build and maintain the implementation project plan, support progress against milestones, and help keep every workstream on schedule.

#### **Platform Configuration, Data Migration, and Integrations (hands\-on)**


* Configure the client's HRIS and complete the build yourself on platforms including ADP Workforce Now, Paylocity, and Rippling, and in our Salesforce environment.
* Run data migrations and validate the results: employee data, payroll history, benefit plans and deductions, and PTO balances.
* Stand up the data interfaces that keep everything in sync, including benefits carrier EDI feeds and GL file feeds, partnering with our internal Technology team where deeper build is required.

#### **Cross\-Functional Partnership**


* Work hand\-in\-hand with Sales, Client Success, Service Delivery, Product, and Finance to align on client expectations, scope, pricing assumptions, and post\-implementation transitions.
* Be the connective tissue that ensures what was sold is what gets delivered.

#### **AI, Automation, and Continuous Improvement**


* Identify and champion opportunities to apply AI, automation, and modern tooling to implementation workflows. This is a priority investment area for Melita.
* Document and improve implementation workflows so each onboarding is faster and cleaner than the last.

#### **What We Are Looking For**


* Very strong, hands\-on experience supporting and implementing outsourced Payroll and HR services, ideally gained at a PEO, an HRO, or an HRIS technology vendor that installs a full HRIS together with outsourced services.
* Hands\-on HRIS implementation experience on one or more major platforms (ADP Workforce Now, Paylocity, or Rippling), including configuration and data migration.
* Hands\-on payroll processing experience, multi\-state processing, tax setup, and mid\-year conversions with YTD balancing
* A proven track record running end\-to\-end implementations and managing a project plan across multiple workstreams and deadlines.
* A natural problem\-solver who thrives on complexity and drives clarity, and a systems thinker who bridges workflows across teams.
* Excellent communication skills and a high\-integrity, client\-first approach.
### **Qualifications:**


#### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience implementing benefits administration and leave of absence services, not only payroll and HR.
* Familiarity with benefits carrier EDI feeds, GL file feeds, and integrations across HRIS, payroll, and benefits systems.
* Experience with Salesforce and with AI\-enabled or automation\-heavy implementation workflows.
* A project management credential (for example PMP or CAPM) is a plus but not required.
* A payroll professional credential (for example FPC or CPP) is a plus but not required.

jobs.description:
JPS Products Inc. \| **Remote**

**Location Requirement:** This is a remote position; however, applicants must currently reside in one of the following states: **Florida, New Jersey, Michigan, Wisconsin, or Texas.**

**About the Role**

JPS Products is a top\-500 Amazon seller known for licensed party supply bundles, with a growing multi\-channel footprint across Amazon, Walmart, and Shopify. We're looking for an Ecommerce Project Manager to serve as the connection between our leadership team and the contractors and virtual assistants (VAs) who execute our day\-to\-day listing, catalog, and marketplace work.

This is a project management and quality\-control role first and foremost. You won't be doing the hands\-on listing edits yourself — you'll be making sure the right work gets to the right contractor, reviewing what comes back, catching what's wrong before it goes live, and keeping projects moving without needing to be chased.

**What You'll Own**

**Listing Maintenance \& Quality Control**

* Identify and assign listing fixes as they come up on current Amazon listings
* Flag and resolve compliance issues on existing listings
* Serve as the go\-between with our advertising agency
* Review account data (stock, ad performance, pricing) to spot inefficiencies and recommend fixes

**VA Team Project Management**

* Manage the VA team's queue of listing updates — images, copy, variations, and A\+ Content enhancements
* Review completed work for accuracy and quality before it's considered done
* Go back and forth with the VA team to correct, clarify, or refine deliverables
* Keep listing\-fix and listing\-creation projects moving along

**New Listing Creation**

* Take new listing concepts from management and translate them into clean, organized specs the VA team can build from
* Ensure new listings are created to spec and launched correctly

**Walmart Marketplace Expansion**

* Monitor Walmart pricing against Amazon to keep them aligned
* Coordinate with the VA team to build out the remaining Walmart catalog

**Shopify Launch (Q1 Project)**

* Act as the internal lead on our new Shopify storefront, even though a third\-party agency will build the site itself
* Drive branding, logo, and site\-direction decisions, bringing ideas and research to the table
* Own coordination through website launch
* Oversee setup of associated social media pages

**Supplier Pitches**

* Help build and support pitches to suppliers on taking over their Amazon optimization

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience managing contractors, VAs, or offshore teams — you're comfortable giving clear direction and holding people accountable to it
* Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central, Walmart Marketplace and Shopify as well as advertising on those platforms
* A sharp eye for catalog quality — you notice when a listing looks off before it costs sales
* Strong project management instincts: you can juggle several workstreams, keep them moving, and know when to escalate
* Comfortable interpreting rough ideas from leadership and turning them into structured briefs others can execute
* Excellent written communication for coordinating across a distributed team
* Thrives in a fast\-paced environment and takes full ownership of projects — relentlessly pushing them forward week after week rather than letting them stall
* Sales experience is a bonus for the supplier pitches, but not required

This role reports directly to the Vice President of Operations and works cross\-functionally with the ad agency and outside development/design partners.

Pay: $40,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* This is a remote position; however, applicants must currently reside in one of the following states: Florida, New Jersey, Michigan, Wisconsin, or Texas. Do you meet this criteria?
* How many years of experience do you have in Ecommerce?

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

  



At APV, we’re more than a technology company — we’re a mission\-driven powerhouse transforming organizations through advanced technology and human ingenuity. If you’re passionate about solving complex challenges and shaping the future, APV is the place for you. Since 2007, we’ve partnered with federal and state agencies to deliver IT, training, and consulting solutions that achieve mission\-critical outcomes. Built on accountability, integrity, and quality, we go beyond expectations. With 70\+ prime contracts and a proven record of client success, APV continues to grow — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

  


**At APV, we Always Provide Value**

  


**POSITION SUMMARY**

  



The 508 Compliance and Quality Assurance Specialist will independently evaluate and help assure the accessibility, completeness, consistency, and production quality of training products. Working with instructional designers, technical writers, graphic artists, eLearning and multimedia specialists, subject matter experts, instructors, and project leadership, this role will test electronic course materials and online learning products against applicable Section 508 and WCAG requirements and perform structured quality reviews throughout the course lifecycle. The specialist will document findings, verify corrections, maintain objective quality records, and support submission of accurate, accessible, macro\-free, editable deliverables that meet client standards and are ready for Government acceptance and use.

  

**DUTIES**

  


* Plan and conduct Section 508 and quality\-assurance reviews for instructor guides, student guides and manuals, presentations, job aids, handouts, practice exercises, assessments, evaluation instruments, reports, plans, eLearning, and other electronic deliverables.
* Test all final electronic course materials and online modules for conformance with Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act, 36 CFR Part 1194, applicable WCAG Level A and AA criteria, and client\-provided accessibility standards.
* Evaluate Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, PDF, and digital\-learning products using appropriate automated tools and manual inspection, including keyboard\-only operation and assistive\-technology checks when applicable.
* Review headings, reading order, navigation, links, tables, lists, form controls, alternative text, captions, transcripts, color contrast, non\-color\-dependent meaning, document properties, language settings, and other accessibility features.
* Prepare and maintain the required Section 508 compliance checklist for each complete course materials package and provide clear evidence that identified defects were corrected before submission.
* Perform independent quality reviews for completeness, internal consistency, formatting, usability, visual identity, file integrity, naming, versioning, links, references, answer keys, and alignment across related course materials.

jobs.title: Training Specialist
jobs.description:
At Colibri Group, culture is at the heart of everything we do. Our values Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork, and Curiosity—guide how we work together, support our customers, and make a difference in the communities we serve.



Colibri Group is a leader in online professional education, serving more than one million learners each year across a family of trusted education brands. Our Customer Service teams support those learners from the front lines, helping them navigate questions, solve problems, and get the most from their experience with Colibri.


**Come Build What’s Next**



We’re looking for a Training Specialist Customer Service to help our Customer Service Representatives build the knowledge, skills, and confidence they need to deliver exceptional customer experiences across voice, chat, and email.



This is an individual contributor role responsible for new hire onboarding, continuous learning, e\-learning development, and performance enablement within a fast\-moving Customer Service environment. You’ll build and facilitate learning experiences, identify opportunities for improvement through performance and Quality Assurance insights, and help teams successfully adopt new tools, processes, and ways of working.



We’re looking for someone who can do more than simply deliver training. You should be equally comfortable building an e\-learning course from the ground up, facilitating an engaging live session, analyzing where employees need additional support, and consulting with stakeholders to recommend the right learning solution.


**What You’ll Do**


* Design, develop, and deliver scalable onboarding, e\-learning, and continuous learning programs that improve and maintain Customer Service Representative performance
* Facilitate engaging live virtual and instructor\-led training across new hire onboarding, upskilling, process changes, technical topics, and ongoing professional development
* Partner consultatively with Customer Service leaders, Quality Assurance, and other stakeholders to identify performance gaps and recommend learning solutions, not simply take training requests at face value

* 3\+ years of experience in training, Learning \& Development, Customer Service, contact center operations, or a related environment
* Hands\-on experiencedeveloping e\-learning and training content, along with demonstrated experience facilitating live virtual and/or instructor\-led learning
* A strong understanding of adult learning principles and the ability to translate complex processes, tools, or information into clear and engaging learning experiences
* A consultative approach to stakeholder partnership, with the confidence to assess needs, ask thoughtful questions, and recommend solutions based on performance needs
* Strong communication, presentation, organization, and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a collaborative, evolving environment

A bachelor’s degree in Education, Business, Organizational Development, or a related field is helpful, but equivalent professional experience is equally valued.


**Tools, Platforms, and Methodologies You May Use**



Experience with every tool or platform below is not required. We are most interested in your ability to build effective learning experiences, learn new technology quickly, and use data to continuously improve training.


* Learning Management Systems (LMS)
* E\-learning and digital content development tools
* Virtual training and collaboration platforms
* Microsoft Office and productivity tools
* Quality Assurance, performance reporting, and learner feedback data

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**


* Own meaningful training programs that directly influence how prepared and confident our Customer Service Representatives are in supporting customers
* Build both live and digital learning experiences rather than being limited to facilitating preexisting content
* Work closely with Customer Service, Quality Assurance, and cross\-functional stakeholders to solve real performance challenges
* Help shape learning programs as Colibri introduces new tools, technologies, processes, and customer service models
* Join a collaborative, supportive team where your creativity, judgment, and ideas are encouraged and your work will have a visible impact

**We Encourage You to Apply**



You may not check every preferred box, and that is okay! Strong candidates may come from contact center training, Customer Service enablement, corporate Learning \& Development, instructional design, technical training, or other high\-volume employee learning environments.



However, this role does require hands\-on experience developing training or e\-learning content and confidently facilitating live learning experiences. If your recent experience has primarily involved coordinating training or delivering materials created entirely by others, this may not provide the depth needed for this particular opportunity.



If you enjoy creating learning experiences, working closely with stakeholders, helping employees grow, and seeing a direct connection between your training and improved performance, we would love to hear from you.


**What You Can Expect From Our Hiring Process**



We want our interview process to give you a clear picture of the role, the team, and what it’s like to work at Colibri while giving us the opportunity to understand your experience, how you approach your work, and what you’re looking for next.


**We do not use AI to review applications. Your application is reviewed by a human

jobs.description:
United States \- Remote


Customer Success/Full time/Remote

  



Role Overview  

The Analytics Specialist owns the success and growth of a dedicated portfolio of Guidewire Analytics clients. Combining customer success, analytics expertise and commercial account ownership, the role helps clients turn Guidewire's data and analytics capabilities into practical business value while driving adoption, retention and growth.  

Guidewire's Analytics portfolio includes predictive modelling, high\-resolution property and hazard data, cyber risk modelling, pooled and anonymised P\&C data and predictive scores, as well as business intelligence capabilities including interactive dashboards and reporting.


**Job Description**

### **Key Areas of Responsibility**

* Own the Client Portfolio: Manage a portfolio of Analytics clients across the full lifecycle, from onboarding and adoption through value realisation, renewal and expansion. Maintain a clear view of client objectives, usage, account health, risks and opportunities, and take ownership of moving the relationship forward.
* Turn Client Challenges into Analytics Use Cases: Understand the decisions, workflows and business problems clients are trying to improve and identify how Guidewire's data and analytics capabilities can help. Translate sometimes ambiguous requirements into practical use cases and support clients in embedding these capabilities into their processes.
* Drive Retention and Commercial Growth: Manage renewal readiness and proactively identify retention risks, working with clients and internal teams to address them. Partner with Sales and Portfolio Leaders to identify and develop credible expansion and cross\-sell opportunities based on client needs, product usage and emerging use cases.
* Lead Client Engagement: Build trusted relationships across business, technical and executive stakeholders. Navigate complex client organisations, identify decision\-makers and champions, manage challenging conversations and provide guidance on how clients can maximise the value of Guidewire Analytics.
* Mobilise Guidewire Around the Client: Bring together Product, Sales, Support, Professional Services and other specialists to resolve issues and advance client objectives. Represent client needs internally, communicate product gaps and emerging requirements, and help connect client priorities with Guidewire's capabilities and product direction.
* Build and Expertise: Develop strong knowledge of Guidewire's Analytics portfolio and relevant data and risk domains. successful use cases and best practices across the client portfolio and contribute to client events, industry discussions and the continued development of Guidewire's Analytics proposition.

### **Experience \& Skills**

* Client and commercial experience: Five or more years in customer success, consulting, sales, account management or a similar client\-facing role, with experience owning complex client relationships and commercial outcomes.
* Data and analytical mindset: Experience working with data, analytics or technology solutions and an ability to understand how data can be applied to business decisions. Experience with weather, natural hazard, property, geospatial, environmental or other risk\-related data is particularly valuable.
* Consultative problem solving: Able to ask the right questions, structure complex or unclear problems and turn business requirements into actionable solutions.
* Technical curiosity: Comfortable discussing APIs, datasets, integrations, analytical models and dashboards without needing to be a software engineer or data scientist.
* Commercial judgement: Able to recognise client risk and growth opportunities, balance client and commercial priorities and confidently navigate renewal, usage and expansion conversations.
* Adaptability and ownership: Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment where products, processes and requirements continue to evolve. Able to make pragmatic decisions with incomplete information, take initiative and adapt quickly as priorities change.
* Influence and collaboration: Able to build credibility with senior, business and technical stakeholders and mobilise people across different teams without direct authority.
* Learning agility: Curious and able to quickly build knowledge of new products, datasets, technologies and use cases. P\&C insurance experience is welcome but not required; familiarity with the use of data in risk selection, pricing, underwriting or claims is advantageous.


The role requires travel to client locations, Guidewire offices and industry events as appropriate

  

The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $114,000 \- $192,000\. Your base pay will depend on your experience, skills, education, training, and location among other factors. All full\-time positions or part\-time roles working 30 hours or more a week at Guidewire are eligible for benefits that support their health and well\-being including health, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and a company sponsored retirement plan. In addition, some roles may be eligible for the annual company bonus plan, commissions, and/or long term incentive awards which are contingent on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, company and employee performance.

jobs.description:
**THE COMPANY**
Invio Automation is a leader in Industry 4\.0, delivering high\-value automation solutions that help customers accelerate growth in specialized markets such as medical devices, life sciences, and advanced manufacturing. With deep domain expertise and extensive engineering capabilities, Invio partners with clients from early\-stage product design and R\&D through to full\-scale automation. Customers value Invio’s commitment to precision, quality, efficiency, and safety, and rely on its innovative, scalable solutions to support long\-term growth. Headquartered in Michigan, Invio Automation is supported by a vast design library, a growing North American presence with global reach, and a team of over 600 experienced professionals across the Midwest and northeast.
Invio operates through two integrated segments:
* The **Solutions Segment** delivers engineered systems for precision manufacturing, including robotic cells, multi\-station assembly lines, and other automation solutions.
* The **Technologies Segment** focuses on advanced autonomous systems and ergonomic tooling, including heavyweight Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs), turnkey assembly solutions, and custom lift\-assist tools for safety\-critical applications.

Together, these segments enable Invio to deliver tailored automation solutions that improve performance and achieve high efficiency across the production lifecycle.
Visit https://invioautomation.com/ for more information.
**DESCRIPTION**
Our sales account managers are tasked with the creative and challenging responsibility of initiating and maintaining relationships within a Fortune 500 customer base to identify, consult, and ultimately execute large tooling and automation projects. The work is diverse and offers an opportunity to combine technologies across Invio’s entire suite of Industry 4\.0 solutions. Typically, most of the work week is spent at factories engaging with existing and potential customers. The remainder of the work week is spent collaborating with Invio’s in\-house design, subject\-matter experts, and estimating teams on proposals, product development roadmaps, and other strategic initiatives.
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
* Bring a minimum of 2 years of experience in a sales role focused on automation solutions, particularly in production line or between process material movement spaces
* Lead strategic customer engagements—particularly within long\-standing accounts—to convert open opportunities into wins.
* Utilize existing personal industry relationships to accelerate sales efforts and expand Invio Automation’s customer base.
* Drive sales of Autonomous Guided Vehicles (AGVs) and Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) by leveraging a proven track record in automation and robotics sales.
* Collaborate with customers to define project scopes and support the development of strong business cases.
* Serve as the “voice of the customer” within Invio, advocating for project quality, timely delivery, and customer satisfaction.
* Position Invio Automation as a preferred partner for advanced material handling solutions in general assembly environments, while actively identifying and developing new business opportunities.
* Expand the portfolio of solutions sold to key accounts, showcasing Invio’s full capabilities—including AGVs, door carriers, vision systems, robotic cells, and sub\-assembly lines.
* Maintain a consistent, in\-person presence at major production facilities, especially in preparation for upcoming vehicle launches.
* Work cross\-functionally with engineering and technical teams to craft innovative, cost\-effective solutions tailored to customer needs.
* Support marketing efforts by contributing to the creation of high\-impact presentations, videos, and digital content aimed at automotive OEMs.
* Partner with the services team to ensure long\-term customer success through proactive service and support offerings.
* Maintain a strong focus on sales performance metrics and KPIs to drive continued growth and accountability.

**Qualifications:**
* To perform this job successfully, an individual must be professional, proactive, and positive. Having a passion for exceptional customer service and support is a must. Being sensitive to the unpredictable demands and uncertainties associated with human resources is a requisite to delivering superior results and exceeding the expectations of our internal and external customers.

**Other Skills and Abilities:**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, problem\-solving, and conflict\-resolution skills
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software
* Proficiency with or the ability to quickly learn the organization’s ERP, and Salesforce system
* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate business objectives into Invio’s sales initiatives
* Willingness to travel within North America, up to 50% of the time

**EDUCATION**
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Sales, Business, Mechanical Engineering or related field required.

**INVIO AUTOMATION’S CORE VALUES**
* We take pride in the reliability of our team and the difficult problems we solve for customers.
* We deliver real customer value that positively impacts the lives of those around us.
* We are dependable. Relationships and trust matter.
* Our ingenuity and desire to improve lives will complement our suite of solutions.
* We strive to demonstrate that our attention to detail does not start or end with the solutions we engineer and deliver.

**Premura Call Centers** builds and runs outbound appointment\-setting call centers for solar, roofing, and home\-improvement companies. Our clients range from individual solar reps to large national installers. Engagements start at $5,500 and run up to $75,000\+, and we currently manage $150,000\-$200,000\+ in monthly recurring revenue.

We are hiring a senior **Customer Success Manager** to own that book of business. This is a high\-end CSM role: you are the person responsible for keeping clients, keeping them happy, and growing them.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the client relationship from onboarding through renewal for a portfolio of solar, roofing, and home\-services accounts.
* Drive retention: monitor account health, get ahead of problems, and run saves when an account is at risk.
* Make sure fulfillment is delivered as promised by coordinating closely with our call center operations team so clients see real results.
* Identify and close upsells and expansions inside existing accounts.
* Collect testimonials, case studies, and referrals from happy clients.
* Run regular client check\-ins, performance reviews, and reporting.
* Be reachable when something urgent comes up. We move fast and our clients notice.

**Who We're Looking For**

* Minimum 6 months of customer success or account management experience; several years is strongly preferred.

The Manager, Workforce Management Scheduling leads a team of WFM Scheduling Analysts supporting both Contact Center and Back Office operations. This role owns schedule publication, real\-time and intraday management, back office inventory and workload management across both environments, and is the primary escalation point for scheduling issues and staffing exceptions.

* Lead and develop a team of WFM Analysts supporting both Contact Center and Back Office operations, providing day\-to\-day coaching, performance management and professional development

* Oversee the production and publication of schedules across Contact Center and Back Office functions, ensuring coverage requirements, service level goals and turnaround time (TAT) commitments are met

* Maintain and enforce scheduling policies and standards, including shift bid processes, time\-off management, exception handling and schedule change procedures
* Partner with the Director of Resource Planning to ensure staffing requirement outputs are accurately translated into executable schedules across all teams

* Oversee real\-time monitoring operations across Contact Center queues and Back Office work queues, ensuring analysts are identifying and responding to intraday staffing variances promptly

* Review intraday performance trends regularly, partnering with operational supervisors to address adherence issues, unexpected volume spikes or staffing shortfalls before they impact service levels or TAT commitments
* Ensure real\-time monitoring standards and tools are consistently applied across both Contact Center and Back Office environments

**Back Office Inventory \& Workload Management**

* Oversee daily and weekly work distribution and queue management processes for Back Office functions, ensuring inventory is assigned to the right staff at the right time based on skills, complexity and regulatory deadlines

* Support the evaluation and implementation of WFM platform enhancements, serving as a key stakeholder in tool configuration, testing and rollout activities

* Lead \& Inspire
* Develop Self \& Others

**What You Bring**

* 2\+ years of experience directly managing a team of WFM analysts or schedulers
* Hands\-on experience with WFM scheduling and real\-time monitoring platforms (e.g., Verint, NICE, Genesys) as well as back\-off

new_jobs.title: Compliance Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Why Socure?**
---------------


Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.


We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

**Compliance Operations Manager**
=================================

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


The line between compliance and technology is disappearing. Financial institutions no longer treat AML programs as a checkbox exercise — they are demanding platforms that embed regulatory intelligence directly into their screening, monitoring, and investigation workflows. Socure is building that platform, and we are looking for a Compliance Operations Manager to be the compliance mind behind it.


This role sits at the center of a four\-way intersection: the evolving regulatory landscape, our product and technology teams, our go\-to\-market motion, and our customers' compliance programs. You will be the compliance partner to engineering and data science, developing the rigorous frameworks, taxonomies, and methodologies that power the context layer underlying our AML platform and features. As regulations evolve — across OFAC, FATF, FinCEN, and international equivalents — you will translate that landscape into product strategy and help shape what Socure builds next.


Beyond internal product work, you will help build Socure's professional services and advisory capability: a program designed to help our customers develop and mature their own AML programs using Socure's platform. You will shape the structure of that program, the partnerships that extend its reach, and the operational model that makes it scalable — positioning Socure as a true compliance partner, not just a technology vendor.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

*Compliance Frameworks \& Context Layer*

* Maintain rigorous frameworks, taxonomies, and methodologies that power the compliance context layer underlying Socure's AML platform — including country risk ratings, sanctions type classification, PEP categorization, and adverse media signal standards – as regulatory guidance, customer requirements, and global coverage expand.
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering to ensure compliance intelligence is accurately represented in Watchlist's data ingestion, entity resolution, and matching systems.
* Maintain and evolve these frameworks leveraging the latest technologies to scale this context layer

*Regulatory Intelligence \& Product Strategy*

* Track developments across OFAC, FATF, FinCEN, and international frameworks and translating them into product and roadmap implications.
* Partner with Product and GTM to shape how regulatory changes become product features, positioning, and customer communications.
* Engage with regulators, industry bodies, and compliance associations to keep Socure at the forefront of the evolving compliance ecosystem.

*Professional Services \& Customer Advisory*

* Help design and build Socure's professional services and advisory capability — a program that helps customers develop and mature their AML programs using Socure's platform.
* Define the structure, partnerships, and operational model that make the advisory program scalable across Socure's growing customer base.
* Work with Sales and Customer Success to deploy compliance advisory as a differentiator in enterprise deals and customer retention.

*Cross\-Functional Collaboration*

* Act as the compliance subject matter expert across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Support enterprise deals with compliance due diligence, RFP responses, and regulatory inquiry support.
* Interface directly with customers on complex compliance questions, audit support, and program design guidance.
* Drive the product roadmap requirements for features that reduce operational complexity for our customers.
* Develop smart automations using AI and agents that reduce operational burden for our cross\-functional partners.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* 5–7 years of experience in AML compliance operations, sanctions screening, or financial crime operations at a financial institution, fintech, or compliance technology company.
* Working knowledge of OFAC sanctions programs, FATF guidance, BSA/AML regulations, and PEP screening standards.
* Experience maintaining or auditing watchlist and sanctions data sources, including list provenance tracking and quality control.
* Familiarity with GRC frameworks and AML taxonomy structures: sanctions type classification, PEP categories, adverse media signals, and country risk ratings.
* Hands\-on technical operator that is able to leverage technology to improve customer experience and scale operations.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage operational processes with rigorous documentation.
* Effective communicator across technical (Engineering, Data Science) and non\-technical (Sales, Compliance Buyers) stakeholders.
* CAMS certification or equivalent AML compliance credential preferred.

 *You must be located in one of our talent hubs: New York, San Francisco, Seattle, or Miami.*

Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.


We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.


We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.


If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**


As Marketing Operations Manager, you will run the day\-to\-day execution that keeps Crusoe's marketing programs moving. Working closely with our marketing operations lead, you will build and QA campaigns across Marketo and Salesforce, manage the data flowing between them, and partner with every team in marketing to get programs live accurately and on time. Alongside that execution work, you will contribute to how the function scales — helping evaluate new capability in our existing stack, improving the processes behind the work, and building AI\-assisted tooling that makes execution faster and more reliable. This role is ideal for a meticulous, systems\-minded operator who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and takes real pride in work that is built right.

 **What You'll Be Working On:**

* Build and configure Salesforce campaigns end to end — audience and list setup, workflow logic, send scheduling, and campaign hierarchy tagging
* Build, QA, and deploy marketing emails and nurture programs in Marketo, including segmentation, A/B setup, link and UTM checks, and send\-time QA
* Build and maintain Marketo forms embedded on Crusoe\-hosted pages, partnering with the web team on placement, tracking, and field mapping
* Stand up Marketo programs for webinars, field events, and product launches, including templates, tokens, smart campaigns, and channel setup
* Run data and list imports end to end — field mapping, normalization, deduplication etc
* Maintain data hygiene across Marketo and Salesforce, including dedupe rules, field standardization, unsubscribes, and sync error resolution
* Partner with Events, Digital, Content, Brand, Web, and Product Marketing through their planning cycles to scope upcoming campaign, email, and automation work, and direct contractor capacity when volume requires it
* Partner with Revenue Operations and Sales on lead routing, lifecycle stages, and scoring, ensuring marketing\-generated leads are accurately assigned in Salesforce and every data point needed for downstream outreach is captured
* Build AI\-assisted tooling and automated workflows that turn recurring operational work into repeatable, reliable processes the whole team can use
* Help evaluate new functionality across the marketing stack, contribute to scoping and integrating new tools, and improve existing processes as the team scales

 **What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 5\+ years of marketing operations or marketing automation experience in B2B environments, with a proven track record of hands\-on campaign execution and data management
* Deep, hands\-on Marketo expertise as a primary builder — programs, smart campaigns, tokens, emails, templates, forms, segmentations, lifecycle, and scoring
* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce — campaigns and campaign members, leads versus contacts, reports and list views — and a practical understanding of how the Marketo sync behaves
* Demonstrated experience importing and cleaning marketing data at volume with a high bar for accuracy
* Experience working across a growing, integrated marketing tech stack, with the ability to trace data across connected systems and diagnose where it breaks
* Practical AI fluency, with experience building AI\-assisted tools or automated workflows that support an operations function
* Strong analytical skills, with experience building reporting that stakeholders rely on and turning campaign and funnel data into clear answers
* Experience supporting a wide variety of stakeholders — web, brand, digital, events, content, product marketing, revenue operations, and sales — and translating their requests into executable work
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing deadlines across many concurrent campaigns
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; Marketo Certified Expert (MCE) a plus
* Familiarity with our wider marketing stack — Sigma, Knak, Qualified, Webflow, Google Analytics, Workato a plus
* Comfort level with ambiguity and ability to operate both strategically and tactically
* Process to stay on top of and implement the latest developments in marketing automation, martech, and AI tooling

 **Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance

new_jobs.title: Business Operations Manager, Ads Sales
new_jobs.description:
Finance and Business Planning is a highly mission\-driven organization. Our mission is to enable Meta to plan, prioritize, and execute as effectively as possible. We take a uniquely long\-term view of business problems. It is critical that we operate with an independent and objective perspective and can represent our point of view to our partners and executive stakeholders. We serve as financial advisers to our business partners and own shared business goals and results where appropriate. We strive to balance our responsibility to support business partners with our responsibility to serve the long\-term mission and sustainability of Meta and act as stewards of the company's resources. This role requires strategic thinking, influencing stakeholders through written proposals, data\-driven presentations, and cross\-functional alignment, an analytical mindset, and a bias towards action. You will be challenged to understand and contribute to rapidly changing business models, drive collaboration across teams, develop recommendations on strategic investment decisions, craft annual and long\-term plans, and partner with leaders to solve problems and achieve goals. In this role, you will take on significant responsibility, work directly with product and business leaders, and contribute to decisions that shape Meta's business strategy.  

  

  

### **Business Operations Manager, Ads Sales Responsibilities:**

* Develop a solid quantitative and qualitative understanding of Meta's Small and Medium Business Group go\-to\-market strategy
* Provide financial leadership across company\-wide planning cycles: long\-range plan (LRP), annual budget, and half\-year roadmapping
* Develop nuanced ROI and impact frameworks across headcount, expenses, and other investments that will influence key decision makers to allocate resources more efficiently
* Create and socialize data\-driven narratives and influence outcomes and decisions at the executive level
* Establish strategic partnerships with leaders of all levels and functions across various business functions
* Help define and implement scalable financial processes to make us and our business partners more efficient

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 9\+ years of experience in business strategy, finance, analytics, consulting, or planning
* Experience in data analytics, data visualization, and scenario\-based analysis
* Experience leading cross\-functional projects with executive stakeholders

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience independently scoping and driving cross\-functional initiatives from problem definition through to execution
* Experience working in a complex, fast\-paced environment or in a high\-growth company
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  

  

  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  

  

Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations\-ext@meta.com.  

  

$162,000/year to $229,000/year \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

### **Company Description**


**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**


Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world\-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.


Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi\-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.


### **Job Description**


We have an opening for an **ESH Business \& Technology Enablement Lead**. In this role, you will gather and translate ESH business and information technology requirements, serve as a liaison between LivIT and ESH business owners, and apply strong project management skills to transform business needs into actionable, sustainable IT solutions. You will support solution evaluation, design, testing, implementation, user adoption, and sustainment, helping ensure that new solutions are effectively understood and used across affected ESH programs and user groups. A strong background and demonstrated experience in ESH operations will be essential as you collaborate across ESH, LivIT, and partner organizations to support project execution and application implementation. This position is within the Operations Department of the Environment Safety \& Health (ESH) Directorate.


*This position may offer a hybrid schedule, which includes the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week, after a probationary period. Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?


**Transform the everyday with us!**


**We are looking for a Quality Assurance Manager.** The Quality Assurance Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and managing comprehensive quality assurance systems and procedures to ensure products, services, and processes consistently meet established quality standards, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations.



As a working manager, this role directly oversees, leads, and mentors the team of quality assurance engineers and managers within the QM\-QA department at the two Trayer Engineering site locations in the SF East Bay (San Leandro and Livermore). Key responsibilities include directing, training, and supervising these professionals, developing strategic quality initiatives, driving continuous improvement, and fostering a robust culture of quality throughout the organization by focusing on process excellence.


**This role will be based onsite in San Leandro and/or Livermore, CA.** *Local candidates are strongly encouraged to apply*. Relocation assistance may be available for eligible candidates. The East Bay offers an excellent quality of life with top\-rated schools, pleasant climate, and easy access to both mountains and the coast. Plus, your compensation goes further here with a more attainable cost of living compared to other parts of the San Francisco Bay Area. Enjoy the perfect blend of small\-city charm and big\-city access.

**About Town**
--------------


We're an applied AI company building a powerful assistant that makes it easy for anyone to create and use software in their everyday work. Town builds a persistent model of you — your voice, judgment, relationships, priorities — and does real work on your behalf across every tool you use: email, calendar, docs, Slack, CRM. It doesn't wait to be prompted. It observes, learns, and acts.


We most recently raised a $55M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Forerunner Ventures and continued support from First Round Capital, Alt Capital, and Conviction — plus angels including Adam D'Angelo, Soleio Cuervo, and Immad Akhund. Our founders, Jean\-Denis and Tony, previously led EPD at Plaid and applied AI product at Google.

**About the role**
------------------


This is a build role. You'll own People Operations at Town end to end — onboarding, payroll, benefits, equity operations, immigration, compliance, HRIS — and design the version of it that still holds at 100 people. Most of what you'll own doesn't exist yet, and you'll build it with the Head of Talent and directly alongside Finance, outside counsel, and both founders. The cornerstone of this role is the latitude to build and decide how this function works.


The best part is that you'll do it at an applied AI company, using our own product on your own workflows. People Ops is full of work that shouldn't be manual, and here you'll have agents, engineers, and a mandate to automate as much of it as you can to keep the human work human.

* Own onboarding end to end, from signed offer letter through 90 day ramp

* Run immigration end to end with outside counsel — H\-1B transfers, E\-3s, green card timelines — and keep employees ahead of their own deadlines.
* Be the first stop for employee questions on benefits, pay, leave, and policy, and handle sensitive issues with discretion and sound judgment.
* Automate the repetitive parts. Town is building tools for people like you, and you'll get to use the most cutting edge, beta\-testing versions of these tools \- you should be using them on your own workflows.

**You might thrive here if you**
--------------------------------

* Have experience in People Ops or HR at a high\-growth startup, ideally with some time as the person building the function (vs just inheriting it)
* Have been responsible for an HRIS and have opinions about how it should be configured.
* Are exceptionally organized and have a bias for automating the behind the scenes, repeatable work to make your and other's lives easier.
* Handle confidential information with total discretion and a steady hand.
* Are in SF and want to be in the office five days a week


Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K
