OPR is seeking an Associate of Client Services to manage a program for a major pharmaceutical client that is focused on embedding the patient perspective in US drug development initiatives during and after product launch. This associate will manage the end\-to\-end process for the client’s US Patient Insight Panels (PIPs), working in close partnership with members of the US Patient Advocacy team and their internal cross\-functional colleagues.


PIPs are organized by disease areas and are comprised of patients, caregivers, and patient advocates who have year\-long consulting agreements with the client to provide feedback on the company’s patient\-facing initiatives such as marketing programs, disease awareness campaigns, patient education, patient support services, and patient experience research. The PIPs are part of the US Patient Advocacy team’s strategy to collaborate with relevant patient communities to understand unmet needs that inform business strategy, mobilize patients to seek the best care and reduce access barriers. Consultations with PIP advisors are entirely virtual.


The client has separate PIPs for various disease areas, including but not limited to:


* Oncology
* Cardiovascular disease
* Immune disorders
* Rare diseases

This individual will be an employee of OPR and will report administratively to OPR, while working day to day under the direction of the client’s US Patient Advocacy team.

  

  

**Key responsibilities**


The client’s US Patient Advocacy department is run internally by Patient Advocacy Leads, each of whom sets strategy and leads collaboration with patient communities from different disease areas. Every Patient Advocacy Lead manages a PIP in their respective disease area. It will be the responsibility of OPR’s Associate of Client Services to provide support to each Patient Advocacy Lead to manage their respective PIPs. This will include:


* Conducting regular update calls with Patient Advocacy Leads to assess their needs
* Managing the process of setting up PIPs in each disease area at the beginning of every year and reconciling PIPs at the end of every year
* Managing timelines, deliverables, meeting preparation, follow\-up, and documentation for PIP projects
* Serving as the primary liaison between internal project teams and PIP advisors, ensuring effective and appropriate engagement throughout project lifecycles
* Maintaining accurate project records, documentation, tracking tools, and databases
* Monitoring advisor participation and project hours to support payment processes
* Identifying opportunities to improve PIP processes, templates, and project workflows, and maintaining and updating PIP standard operating procedures to align with evolving company practices
* Serving as a subject matter expert on the PIP consulting model, providing guidance and answering questions from advisors and internal cross\-functional colleagues
* Anticipating client needs and proactively identifying issues, risks, and next steps
* Helping to maintain strong client relationships through clear, responsive, and thoughtful communication
* Following all applicable laws and client policies, and reporting any instances of non\-compliance to the client’s Legal and Compliance departments
* Promoting the responsible use of AI\-enabled tools to strengthen PIP program quality, consistency, and efficiency

Training will be provided on OPR’s PIP processes, client systems, and relevant tools.

  

  

**Qualifications**


***Required***


* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, public health, communications, healthcare administration, social sciences, or a related field
* Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare consulting, patient advocacy, patient engagement, medical affairs, clinical development, or a related healthcare field
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage timelines, details, and multiple workstreams
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience working with clients, internal stakeholders, or external partners
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment
* Strong judgment, professionalism, and attention to detail
* Proficient with Microsoft Office tools, including Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and SharePoint
* Interest in patient\-centered healthcare and the importance of integrating patient and caregiver perspectives throughout drug development and commercialization

***Preferred***


* Experience working with or within pharmaceutical patient advocacy functions
* Experience engaging with patient advocacy organizations or patient communities
* Experience supporting advisory boards, insight panels, interviews, workshops, or qualitative research
* Ability to translate scientific or clinical topics into clear, patient\-friendly language
* Consulting, agency, or client\-service experience
* Experience working with AI enabled tools

**Compensation**


The salary for this position is expected to range between $85,000 and $115,000 per year. The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience. Full\-time OPR employees receive a benefits package that includes health insurance, a Simple IRA with company contribution and match, and paid time off for vacation, sick days and holidays.

STR Operations Manager / Founder’s Right Hand

**Future Director of Operations / GM Opportunity**

**$22–$27/hr \| \~20 Hours/Week to Start \| 90\-Day Paid Trial**

This Is Not a Typical Part\-Time Operations Job

We are looking for an experienced **short\-term rental operator with the ambition and capability to eventually help run multiple growing businesses.**

This position starts part\-time because several of our newest growth initiatives are still ramping.

**The position is not intended to stay small.**

We operate businesses in short\-term rental revenue management, remote STR management, and home services. We have established operations, active leads, new services launching, and significant growth opportunities.

The founder has become too involved in day\-to\-day execution.

We need someone who can eventually become the founder’s **\#2**.

The right person won't simply manage what exists. You'll help us **build and scale what comes next.**

Professional STR Experience Is Required

You should already understand professional STR operations, including:

* Airbnb/Vrbo
* Owner and guest communication
* Property onboarding
* Listing setup/optimization
* Cleaners and maintenance
* PMS platforms such as Guesty, Hospitable, Hostaway, etc.
* PriceLabs or similar dynamic pricing software
* STR performance and revenue\-management fundamentals

Experience professionally operating **20\+ STR properties is strongly preferred**.

We need someone who already understands this industry—not someone we need to teach STR operations from scratch.

What You'll Do

You'll initially work directly with the founder to:

* Coordinate STR client onboarding and operations
* Manage owner communication and routine client issues
* Keep leads, contracts, and onboarding moving
* Coordinate with revenue managers and other team members
* Help manage GoHighLevel CRM and automations
* Improve listings and operational processes
* Build SOPs and scalable systems
* Track KPIs and identify problems
* Follow up with employees and contractors
* Help oversee operations within our home\-services company
* Hold team members accountable
* Solve routine operational problems without involving the founder

Most importantly, you'll help us **scale**.

When we add another 20, 50, or 100 properties, we want you thinking:

**What needs to change? Who do we need? What should we automate? What will break next? How do we grow without creating chaos?**

We don't want to push someone to think this way.

We're looking for someone who naturally does.

Who We're Looking For

You might currently be an STR Operations Manager, Portfolio Manager, Senior Property Manager, or similar professional who knows you're capable of more.

You:

* Take ownership without being chased
* Solve problems before they become emergencies
* Build systems instead of repeatedly fixing the same problem
* Can lead and hold people accountable
* Understand numbers and KPIs
* Communicate professionally with owners
* Make good decisions independently
* Learn technology quickly
* Use automation and AI intelligently
* Think ahead as a company grows
* Want your responsibility and career to grow with the business

We want someone who increasingly tells the founder:

**“I've already handled it.”**

The Upside

Our philosophy is simple:

**The more value you create and the more these businesses grow, the more opportunity there should be for you to grow with them.**

A successful person can progress toward:

**Operations Manager → Director of Operations → General Manager / Founder’s \#2**

That can mean increased hours, compensation, authority, team leadership, and performance\-based compensation opportunities as the role develops.

Advancement isn't automatic. It will be earned through results.

But we are specifically recruiting someone who has the **capability to grow far beyond the starting position.**

Compensation

**$22–$27/hour depending on experience**

Approximately **20 hours/week initially**

**90\-day paid trial**

We will evaluate progress around Days 30, 60, and 90 based on ownership, reliability, problem\-solving, leadership, systems improvement, and how much operational responsibility you've successfully taken from the founder.

Strong performance can lead to increased hours, compensation, responsibility, and a long\-term leadership position.

**We're looking for someone who may eventually become an exceptional operator and business leader.**

Pay: $22\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

* How many STR properties have you professionally helped operate, and what were you personally responsible for?
* Why are you interested in a position that starts part\-time but could develop into running a much larger operation?
* Which PMS, pricing, CRM, and STR platforms have you used?

Work Location: Remote

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------



As an Associate Revenue Operations Analyst, Policy \& Rules of Engagement, you will help the Field Sales team apply go\-to\-market policies consistently. You will learn to support requests and policy\-related disputes, maintain documentation and data, and help make processes easier to understand and use. This is an entry\-level, remote role aligned to time zones in the United States.


**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Support the documentation and maintenance of go\-to\-market policies and rules of engagement for the Field Sales team.
* Respond to policy questions and support the resolution of policy\-related disputes through Salesforce Chatter, case requests, and the Sales Support Slack channel.
* Apply established policies carefully and identify questions that need escalation.
* Maintain accurate data, process documentation, and best practices for first\-tier sales teams.
* Work with operations, strategy, sales compensation, and sales systems partners to support consistent processes.
* Identify documentation or process gaps and share them with the appropriate team members.
* Support policy updates and annual planning activities as business needs change.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------


* Interest in revenue or sales operations, policies, and the systems that support go\-to\-market teams.
* Experience working carefully with data, documentation, or administrative processes through coursework, internships, projects, or previous roles.
* Ability to review information closely, identify issues, and document clear next steps.
* Ability to organize multiple requests, prioritize work, and meet deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for working with stakeholders across teams.
* Interest in supporting policy application and resolving questions or disputes fairly and consistently.
* Demonstrated curiosity by asking questions, learning new processes, and taking ownership of assigned work.
* Salesforce administration experience or familiarity with Salesforce is a plus.

The Revenue Operations team supports go\-to\-market teams by building and maintaining the processes, policies, and systems they use to serve customers. We work asynchronously with partners across GitLab to make rules of engagement clear, consistent, and scalable as business needs evolve.
